name: Dying Exile
summary: Wounded fellow exile on the beach who points the player toward smoke at ruins.

name: Eagon Caeserius
summary: Scholar and Atlas researcher who claims Zana as his sister and Valdo as father; chases the Originator's memory threads with the exile via Memory Tears and Astrolabes. Hints that his parentage is uncertain ('If I am not Valdo's bastard...'); his identity is a community mystery.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_threads_of_the_originator", "locator": "walkthrough"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_threads_of_the_originator", "locator": "Speak to Eagon quest log; Memory Vault dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_ggg_secrets_of_the_atlas_forum", "locator": "dev commentary: Eagon's situation remains complicated"}]

name: Eber, the Plaguemaw
summary: Boss of the Pale Council encounter in The Pale Court (Prophecy system). Introduced in 2.3.0; the wiki marks the Pale Council fight as removed from the game in 3.17.0.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eber_the_plaguemaw", "locator": "Infobox: location = The Pale Court; header 'The prophecy system was removed ... in version 3.17.0. The Pale Council fight no longer exists'; Version history 2.3.0 'Introduced to the game'"}]

name: Egrin
summary: Young Azmeri whose visions may have led the descent; later cast out and taken in by the Order of the Djinn.

name: Einhar Frey
summary: Master-NPC beastmaster who teaches the Exile to capture beasts and runs the Menagerie; appears in Act 2 (Forest Encampment, Einhar's Hunt).

name: Ekbab, Ancient Steed
summary: Guardian of the Mastodon Tusks in the Bone Pits, assisted by Iktab; defeated to obtain the Tusks for Zarka.

name: The Elder
summary: Entity of malignant madness and servant of the Decay that preyed on children, feeding on their nightmares and later on Valdo's memories. Released by Venarius, it hunted the Atlas until the exile and Zana expelled it with the Cosmic Arcana; a memory of it remains as a pinnacle boss (Uber Elder).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "The Watchers of Decay / Zana"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_decay", "locator": "Servants: The Elder"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_elder_quest", "locator": "lead 'memory of The Elder'"}]

name: Elder Guardian: Constrictor
summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Constriction, part of the Key to Decay.

name: Elder Guardian: Enslaver
summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Enslavement, part of the Key to Decay.

name: Elder Guardian: Eradicator
summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Eradication, part of the Key to Decay.

name: Elder Guardian: Purifier
summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Purification, part of the Key to Decay.

name: Elder Madox
summary: Elder of the Azmeri of Mount Kriar, found trapped by a Delirium mirror in a map; freed, he says the Winter Owl spoke to him of the Raven Trickster's return and asks the Exile to retrace the tale 'The Raven and the Hare' to the Withered Willow.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_strange_reflection", "locator": "Elder Madox: 'I am Elder Madox of the Azmeri of Mount Kriar. The Winter Owl spoke to me. His enemy returns. The Raven Trickster...'"}, {"source_id": "src_web_domistae_poe2_endgame_guide", "locator": "Elder Maddox trapped in a Trickster trance (guide spelling)"}]

name: Elreon, Loremaster
summary: Exiled Templar who believed thaumaturgy a divine gift; forsaken master (jewellery). Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Elzarah, the Cobra Lord
summary: Elzarah, the Cobra Lord is a boss the Exile defeats in the Sel Khari Sanctuary during the Recruit the Maraketh interlude.

name: The Empty-Eyed Fiend
summary: Entity Olroth could not defeat with blade or flame, prompting him to use gems; the Kalguur page links it to The Elder (identification inferred).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "The Broken Circle"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "Thaumaturgy section (link to The Elder)"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "'The Broken Circle'"}]

name: The Envoy
summary: Messenger NPC met in T6+ maps who introduces the Maven and the Eldritch Horrors, speaking of the Struggle over the Atlas; speaks of Cleansing Fire's blindness to 'the lightkeeper'. Also gives the Flesh Compass and Luminous Astrolabe that let the Exile hunt the Tangle's and Cleansing Fire's footholds.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_maven_quest", "locator": "Walkthrough"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_cleansing_fire", "locator": "Envoy dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_decay", "locator": "Envoy: The Maven dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_atlas_of_worlds", "locator": "Walkthrough: Envoy gives Flesh Compass / Luminous Astrolabe"}]

name: Eramir
summary: Scholar from Theopolis (he looked after its museum) living at the Bridge Encampment; he translates the Vaal inscriptions on the relic that washed ashore, identifies the god Ralakesh and asks the exile to end Greust's possession. He fears another theocratic dictatorship.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_deal_with_the_bandits", "locator": "Quest header: start=Talk to Eramir"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_master_of_a_million_faces", "locator": "Eramir"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "Valdo: 'until Eramir sent in ancient parchments'"}]

name: Essie and Paulius
summary: Paired Act 5 boss in datamine. Unreleased; no lore available.

name: Evilandra
summary: Hostile 'evil' reflection of Kalandra (ArbiterWildEvil in game files). She rarely appears in the Lake and has her own tile dialogue.

name: The Exile (PoE1)
summary: The player's character in PoE1: a convict sentenced to Wraeclast by High Templar Dominus in 1599-1600 IC. The character washes up on the Twilight Strand, escapes a Templar boat, and fights through Acts 1-10 (defeating Dominus in Act 3, Voll's remains in Act 4, High Templar Avarius and Innocence in Act 5, and Kitava in Act 10 with Sin) and the Atlas storylines.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "section 'The Present'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_order_of_the_templar", "locator": "section 'Lore' (exile escapes Templar boat; defeats Dominus, Avarius, Kitava)"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_act_1", "locator": "lead"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_incursion_league", "locator": "lead"}]

name: The Exile (PoE2)
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "about 20 years after Kitava's defeat (PoE2 campaign)", "story_order": null}
summary: The PoE2 protagonist: an Exile in Ogham, sentenced to death by Count Geonor. After escaping the Executioner by jumping into the ocean, the Exile chases the Seed of Corruption released by Geonor across Wraeclast about 20 years after Kitava's death.

name: Farrow
summary: PoE2 NPC who studies runes on Verisium Remnants (Runes of Aldur) and worries about Kingsmarch, sending the Exile in The Grand Expedition.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_runeseeker", "locator": "quest log"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_runes_of_aldur_league", "locator": "League content"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_grand_expedition", "locator": "Quest log"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_runeseeker", "locator": "Speak to Farrow"}, {"source_id": "src_web_gamedeveloper_return_of_the_ancients", "locator": "Farrow, a young blacksmith"}, {"source_id": "src_web_pcgamesn_return_of_the_ancients", "locator": "rescue Farrow in Clearfell"}]

name: Faustus, the Financier
summary: Former Heist captain turned Kingsmarch financier running the Currency Exchange, respec and Black Market; writes of waiting and watching the King; reported dead in PoE2 ('rest his soul').

name: Fidelitas, the Mourning
summary: Former slave Raulo, Maligaro's loyal lover/servant, deformed into a monster that guards the Baleful Gem.

name: Gaius Sentari
summary: Ezomyte slavemaster and governor beaten at Glarryn; ran Highgate 'civilization camps'.

name: General Gravicius
summary: Dominus's assistant in artifact gathering, Ebony Barracks boss; fire-damage specialist.

name: Archbishop Geofri
summary: Archbishop of Phrecia Cathedral killed by Maligaro; undead guardian in Act 2.

name: Count Geonor (Enigma Chamber)
summary: Count Geonor returns as an endgame challenge fight in the Precursor Enigma Chambers of Legacy of the Precursors.

name: Ghorr, the Grasping Maw
summary: Scourge boss that can spawn in the Nightmare realm depending on the monsters present; the wiki gives stats and no individual lore.

name: Gianna
summary: Deception rogue (the Master of Disguise). Backstory: she worked at the Theopolis Thespian Society in Oriath, and her early contracts involve Templar uniforms. Unlocked by a Vinderi contract.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_gianna_the_master_of_disguise", "locator": "Lead and Lore: Theopolis Thespian Society; \"To unlock Gianna, run a contract with Vinderi\""}]

name: Gravicius Reborn
summary: Former Act 3 general, resurrected Syndicate member. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Greust
summary: Azmeri-friendly villager of the Forest Encampment (his shrine and necklace follow Azmeri custom) who becomes the avatar of Ralakesh through a washed-up Vaal relic in Act 7; the exile must kill him to force Ralakesh back into the relic. Helena asks that his necklace be laid at the Azmeri shrine in the Northern Forest.

name: Grigor
summary: Poet-scholar of the Sarn Encampment who knows the ode 'Of Jewels and Eternity', sends the Exile to the Gemling Queen, then after Piety and Dominus; Maramoa says to 'look upon Grigor to see what life entails under Piety's influence'.

name: Guardian of the Void: Chimera
summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Chimera, part of the Key to the Crucible.

name: Guardian of the Void: Hydra
summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Hydra, part of the Key to the Crucible.

name: Guardian of the Void: Minotaur
summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Minotaur, part of the Key to the Crucible.

name: Guardian of the Void: Phoenix
summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Phoenix, part of the Key to the Crucible.

name: Guatelitzi
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "Vaal era (inferred from Atziri's Temple drop location; no date stated)", "story_order": null}
summary: Figure known only from the flavour text of Guatelitzi's Ablation (drop location Atziri's Temple): as a young man he was found among prisoners 'preparing their living bodies for sacrifice', and the High Priests recognised his inclinations and gave him a higher calling. Vaal placement is inferred from the Atziri's Temple drop location, not stated.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_guatelitzi_s_ablation", "locator": "flavour_text: 'Young Guatelitzi was found moving among the prisoners, preparing their living bodies for sacrifice. The High Priests recognised his inclinations, and gave him a higher calling.'"}]

name: Guff "Tiny" Grenn
summary: Syndicate member from the Brinerot warband. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Gwennen, the Gambler
summary: Kalguuran gambler and former rebel who avoids Kingsmarch because Johan, scarred by her, could recognise her and expose surviving rebels.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_letter_kingsmarch_", "locator": "Dear Rog (Gwennen)"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "Monarchy: failed rebellion"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_expedition_league", "locator": "League mechanic: NPCs"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "Notable members: Current"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_grand_expedition", "locator": "Search for Gwennen"}, {"source_id": "src_web_gamedeveloper_return_of_the_ancients", "locator": "his missing wife, Gwennen"}]

name: Hailrake
summary: Boss of the Tidal Island holding Doctor Opden's Medicine Chest.

name: Haku, Armourmaster
summary: Karui forsaken master (armour); Syndicate member. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Hargan
summary: Sarn Encampment weapon/armour vendor; fence who seeks Victario's busts for his 'return to Oriath' fund.

name: Hayoxi
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "Vaal era (inferred from royal-temple setting; no date stated)", "story_order": null}
summary: Figure called 'The Architect of Destruction' in the flavour text of Hayoxi's Fulmination, who laid explosive powder under the royal temple 'one pinch at a time' and never found the courage to light it. Identity beyond the flavour text is not recorded in the corpus. Placement in the Vaal era is inferred from the royal-temple setting.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_hayoxi_s_fulmination", "locator": "flavour_text: 'The Architect of Destruction slipped explosive powder under the royal temple one pinch at a time. For years, he clung to that, never finding the courage to light it.'"}]

name: Hector Titucius, Eternal Servant
summary: One of the Undying: murderer of the Maraketh Sekhema Asenath (the Golden Sekhema), who again guards her Wings of Vastiri in the Bath House; Hargan wants the Wings to ransom back to the Maraketh.

name: Heldra of the Black Pyre
summary: Heldra of the Black Pyre is a foe the Exile defeats in Scorched Farmlands alongside Isolde of the White Shroud during the Recruit the Ezomytes interlude.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_ezomytes", "locator": "Quest log, 'Defeat Isolde and Heldra' ('Defeat Isolde of the White Shroud and Heldra of the Black Pyre.')"}]

name: Helena
summary: Young Oriathan Ebony Legion woman rescued from the Chamber of Sins; joins the Forest Encampment and directs the Lorrata plan.

name: Herius
summary: Priest 'of the Order' listed as a Twilight Order member under Torvian, Hand of the Saviour. No further detail in sources read.

name: Hilda
summary: Monster hunter and Atlas Master (Hilda's Campsite); her endgame quest Hilda's Hunting has the Exile track and defeat four Great Beasts.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_web_gamedeveloper_return_of_the_ancients", "locator": "Atlas Masters: Hilda, a monster hunter"}, {"source_id": "src_web_domistae_poe2_endgame_guide", "locator": "Hilda (Monster Hunters Guild)"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_hilda_s_hunting_quest_", "locator": "Quest Complete: 'You have tracked and defeated four Great Beasts.'"}]

name: Hillock, the Blacksmith
summary: Act 1 boss Hillock resurrected by the Mastermind and joined the Syndicate. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_hillock", "locator": "lead + Lore"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_betrayal_league", "locator": "Members"}, {"source_id": "src_yt_6tP4TcFw4Lo", "locator": "1:55 forsaken masters; 12:25 other members"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_hillock", "locator": "Lore section; Mechanics"}, {"source_id": "src_ingame_hillock", "locator": "Lore section; Mechanics"}]

name: Huck
summary: Former soldier who joined the Ring after his discharge and hunts a lost friend, Enoch, who died in Templar research on augmentations. Hireable in Heists; unlocked by a Karst contract, and his contract unlocks Niles.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_huck_the_soldier", "locator": "Lead; Personal Questline; \"To unlock Huck, run a contract with Karst\" (Niles page); \"Took it out not long after joining the Ring\""}]

name: Queen Hyrri Ngamaku
summary: Kaom's niece, archer, led Karui archers at Lioneye's Watch and the Karui at the Grain Gate; after Kaom's death guided the remaining 500 Karui families home, became queen, had a child with Victario (per wiki) and was succeeded by her daughter Ahuana; later vanished.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "'Lioneye's Watch'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_victario", "locator": "'Lore'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_queen_hyrri_ngamaku", "locator": "Lore: 'She later became the queen and had a child with Victario ... succeeded by her daughter, Ahuana'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_queen_hyrri_ngamaku", "locator": "lead + Lore"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_king_kaom", "locator": "Purity Rebellion; In-game"}]

name: Icius Perandus
summary: Eternal Empire-era scholar and translator of Vaalish texts (name suggests the Perandus family, not verified); hid four Golden Pages in the Sarn Archives; friend of Siosa; also cited as author of the 'Chronicle of Atzoatl'.

name: Ignagduk, the Bog Witch
summary: Azak tribe unique boss of The Azak Bog in Act 3, who holds stolen children; slain in the Tribal Vengeance quest, dropping Ignagduk's Ghastly Spear.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_tribal_vengeance", "locator": "Infobox (boss Ignagduk, the Bog Witch); lead: 'Find Ignagduk in the Azak village'"}]

name: Ikiaho
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead", "story_order": null}
summary: Chieftain of the Arohongui tribe, loyal to Arohongui; vouched for Rakiata in the Halls of the Dead and tells that Ramako was impersonated.

name: Iktab, the Deathlord
summary: Undead lord assisting Ekbab in the Bone Pits.

name: Incarnation of Dread
summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Reverence: Valdo's promise of a brighter future.

name: Incarnation of Fear
summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Trauma: Valdo's fury at Zana.

name: Incarnation of Neglect
summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Loneliness: Zana asks Valdo to admire the Atlas; 'Not now, Zana!'. Interpretive: its Valdo/Zana 'Not now, Zana!' memory suggests it embodies Valdo's neglect; the wiki does not state this.

name: The Infinite Hunger
summary: Primary champion of the Tangle fought in the Seething Chyme.

name: Inya, the Unbearable Whispers
summary: Boss of the Pale Council encounter in The Pale Court (Prophecy system). Introduced in 2.3.0 and removed in 3.17.0 per the wiki; in 3.0.0 the Pale Council was rebalanced and Inya became a drop source for Inya's Epiphany.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_inya_the_unbearable_whispers", "locator": "Infobox: location = The Pale Court; Drops: 'guaranteed to drop Inya's Epiphany ... if she was the last one to be killed ... the sequence ... is random'; Version history 3.17.0 'Removed from the game'"}]

name: Irasha
summary: Maraketh akhara of Highgate and rival of Tasuni for rule after Oyun's disappearance. Her twin sister died of a scorpion's sting during the womanhood trial; she asks the exile to kill Shakari and may receive the Sekhema Feather.

name: Isla, the Engineer
summary: Engineer building Kingsmarch's map devices and the Recombinator; her letter ('I'm so happy you're alive!') hints at a past connection with the Exile and mentions Kalguuran runes' strange effect on portals.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_kingsmarch_mapping", "locator": "Isla dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_letter_kingsmarch_", "locator": "Oil-smudged Letter"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_isla_the_engineer", "locator": "Lead and Lore: \"a skillset she acquired working under Inquisitor Dominus\""}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "Valdo Caeserius: 'Venarius picked out Isla'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_threads_of_the_originator", "locator": "Machinist's Vault quotes"}]

name: Isolde of the White Shroud
summary: Isolde of the White Shroud is a Holten-linked foe the Exile defeats in Scorched Farmlands alongside Heldra of the Black Pyre during the Recruit the Ezomytes interlude.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_ezomytes", "locator": "Quest log, 'Defeat Isolde and Heldra' ('Defeat Isolde of the White Shroud and Heldra of the Black Pyre.')"}]

name: It That Fled
summary: Breach-realm creature that fled the Breachlords' rule and is listed among Immortal Syndicate members; most Syndicate members fear it. (Not in Keepers league.) Identity beyond that unclear.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_yt_6tP4TcFw4Lo", "locator": "13:26 \"being from the breach realm who fled the rule of the Breachlords\"; 17:53 most members terrified of it"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_keepers_league", "locator": "restrictions: It That Fled cannot appear in the Immortal Syndicate"}]

name: It That Was Esh
summary: Hive Colony boss fought together with It That Was Tul (PoE1 3.27/3.28, PoE2 0.5.0). Per Ailith it is not the original Esh but possibly Esh's leftover remains after the fusion into Xesht.

name: It That Was Tul
summary: Hive Colony boss fought together with It That Was Esh (PoE1 3.27/3.28, PoE2 0.5.0); drops the Breachlord Sac / Breach rings. Per Ailith it is not the original Tul but possibly Tul's leftover remains after the fusion into Xesht.

name: Ixan Keita
summary: Founder of House Keita, one of the four Great Founders who rebelled against Emperor Tyndarus Phrecius.

name: Ixchel
summary: Vaal Order of the Djinn member ('Godstealer') who stole the sleeping body of Yaomac for the Order; captured while infiltrating the Temple of Chaos and became the Trialmaster.

name: Emperor Izaro
summary: The last Phrecian emperor, impotent from inbreeding, who built the Lord's Labyrinth in 1317 IC to choose a successor. Sealed inside by Chitus. The Exile can still meet him as an enemy in the Labyrinth.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "'Reign of Izaro'; 'Reign of Chitus'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "section 'Reign of Izaro'; section 'Reign of Chitus'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_lords_labyrinth_quest", "locator": "infobox boss=Izaro"}]

name: Jado
summary: Member of the Order of the Djinn first met in Interlude 2; reveals Jun has been rebuilding the Order in secret for 20 years since Catarina's fall. Atlas Master in 0.5, unlocked via an anomaly map near the Atlas start.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_maraketh", "locator": "Speak to Asala / Jado"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_order_of_the_djinn", "locator": "first mentioned by Jado, NPC introduced in Interlude 2"}, {"source_id": "src_web_gamedeveloper_return_of_the_ancients", "locator": "Atlas Masters: Jado of the Order of the Djinn"}, {"source_id": "src_ggg_content_update_0_5_0", "locator": "Jado questline unlocked by completing an anomaly map near the starting location"}]

name: Jaetai, Vaal Advisor
summary: Vaal advisor to Atziri mentioned only on the flavour text of Atziri's Foible.

name: Jamanra, the Risen King
summary: Faridun leader resurrected by the Countess, who locks the Halani Gates, summons sandstorms, and is later executed by Sekhema Asala as Jamanra the Abomination.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_faridun", "locator": "'Events in Path of Exile 2'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_trail_of_corruption_act_2", "locator": "Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Risen King' / 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_faridun", "locator": "Events in Path of Exile 2"}]

name: Janus Perandus
summary: Great-grandson of Chitus Perandus; former Order of the Djinn member and gambling addict who betrayed the order to Catarina and joined the Syndicate.

name: Johan, the King's Hand
summary: Kalguuran official sent to execute Kingsmarch's Charter as the King's Hand and Treasurer; admits loyalty to both the King and the Charter's law; tolerates 'less than upstanding' residents so long as he sees no sedition. He bears a scar given by Gwennen.

name: Julius Perandus
summary: Father of Chitus.

name: Jun Ortoi
summary: Master NPC, survivor and guardian of the Forbidden Vaults of the Order of the Djinn; hunts the Syndicate after its killing of her order. Introduced in Betrayal; Act 9 quest "The Immortal Syndicate".
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_betrayal_league", "locator": "lead"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_immortal_syndicate", "locator": "quest in Act 9"}, {"source_id": "src_yt_6tP4TcFw4Lo", "locator": "1:05 Jun Ortoi, Order of the Djinn"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_order_of_the_djinn", "locator": "Members: Jun (mention only)"}]

name: Justicar Casticus
summary: Templar justicar in the Control Blocks whose Eyes of Zeal give entry to the Templar Courts.

name: Kadavrus the Defiler
summary: Necromancer boss of the Fetid Pool who was raising the dead rhoa.

name: Kahuturoa
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead", "story_order": null}
summary: Chieftain of the Rongokurai tribe per the Karui page (some history text files him with the Ramako tribe); recounts Ramako, Kitava's defeat and the Maraketh 'thousand years'.

name: Kaimana
summary: Karui healer-alchemist at Ngakanu working on a Blood Fever cure; sends the Exile for the Great White shark's fin. Says 'If the ancestors see you... you can never truly die'.

name: K'aj A'alai
summary: Third demon of the Vaal Temple map boss trio, variants of the Atziri trio; all released with Sacrifice of the Vaal.

name: K'aj Q'ura
summary: Unique demon boss in the Vaal Temple map, a variant of the Atziri trio; uses Demon Cleave (Corrupted Blood) and Cyclone.

name: K'aj Y'ara'az
summary: Unique demon boss in the Vaal Temple map; one of a trio that are variants of the Atziri trio of the Apex of Sacrifice. Uses Dual Strike and Fire Enrage.

name: Kalandra
summary: Ancient being with an owl's body and human head, trapped in the Lake of Kalandra since the primordial era; she observes the world, scorns gods as 'thieves of virtue', and plans escape. Visited by the Order of the Djinn and the Clayshaper among others. Namesake of the Mirror of Kalandra.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalandra", "locator": "Lore 'Ancient Etchings'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_beast", "locator": "paragraph 2"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalandra", "locator": "lead; Lore: Ancient Etchings"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_god", "locator": "Kalandra section"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "section 'The Lake of Kalandra'"}]

name: Kanu
summary: First Mate of the Aurora May, listed among Twilight Order members: he is courted by Benedictus ('Accept Utopia!'), betrays Makoru, then reveals the Beast is kept in Oriath and is attacked by Tavakai ('Let the ancestors judge him') - death is implied.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_twilight_order", "locator": "Members: Kanu"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Confront Kanu and the First Herald; Defeat Benedictus"}]

name: King Kaom
summary: Karui king who took Lioneye's Watch, was lured to Highgate by Malachai's voice posing as Tukohama and slain; defeated in Act 4.

name: Karst
summary: Lockpicking rogue in the Rogue Harbour; a Ring member (Kurai: 'assist member Karst') who aids the exile on the Trial Run contract and whose hire unlocks Huck.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_karst_the_lockpick", "locator": "Lead and Walkthrough"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_rogue_harbour_quest", "locator": "Walkthrough: \"Talk to Karst, the Lockpick, the rogue that aids you\""}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kurai_the_administrator", "locator": "'The Ring' dialogue: 'assist member Karst on this job'"}]

name: Kastov
summary: Governor of Stridevolf in the Eternal Empire who joined High Templar Voll's Purity Rebellion in 1333 IC against the gemling thaumatocracy. Per the Victario page, unlike Voll, Ondar, Geofri and Adus he did not turn undead or into a ghost in the in-game present.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_purity_chronicles", "locator": "intro paragraph: 'Governor Kastov of Stridevolf' listed among Voll's allies with Lord Mayor Ondar, Victario, Archbishop Geofri and Commander Adus"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_victario", "locator": "paragraph 'In 1333 IC, Victario supported the Purity Rebellion ... along with Kastov, Lord Mayor Ondar, Archbishop Geofri and Commander Adus'; and 'neither Victario nor Kastov turned into the undead or a ghost'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "section '==Members==' > Purity Rebellion rebels: '** [[Kastov]], Governor of [[Stridevolf]]'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_stridevolf", "locator": "section 'Notable members': 'Governor Kastov of Stridevolf'"}]

name: Kelari
summary: The assassin Djinn bound to serve the Sekhema Varashta as penance; an invulnerable minion of the Disciple of Varashta ascendancy that stays inert in its barya until commanded.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_disciple_of_varashta", "locator": "section 'Overview': 'The three Djinns are Ruzhan the fire Djinn, Navira the water Djinn, and Kelari the assassin Djinn.'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_disciple_of_varashta", "locator": "section 'Overview': 'Each the Djinn are invulnerable minions that remain inert in their Baryas until the Disciple commands them to unleash their powers.'"}]

name: Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun
summary: Vaal High Priest of the Sun whose writings Alva cites about research in the Temple of Kopec (device/time gateway); boss in the Temple of Kopec defeated by the Exile in PoE2 Act 3.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "Quest 'Defeat Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "quest log"}]

name: Kiloava
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead", "story_order": null}
summary: Chieftain of the Valako tribe, absorbed by Kaom's conquests; speaks on how tribes may change their gods.

name: King Cadigan
summary: Mysterious tyrant-king of Kalguur whose name all kings share (possibly one person extending life by artifice); spies on subjects, instituted shipment taxes, has his eye on Wraeclast, and in PoE2 ordered Vaal artifacts brought home.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "'===Monarchy==='"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_johan_the_king_s_hand", "locator": "'The King' dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kingsmarch", "locator": "Negative outcomes: 'The King decided to institute a one-time tax'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "Monarchy section"}]

name: King Cadigan the Third
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "Shortly after the Vaal Cataclysm (first Kalguuran expedition)", "story_order": null}
summary: Kalguuran king who, after reading the Vaal Cataclysm as an 'Omen', commissioned the first expedition to Wraeclast with the Triskelion Flame and banned gems after the Azmeri panicked at the sight of one.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "Expedition; Colonisation"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "Triskelion Flame + Thaumaturgy sections"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "'Expedition to Wraeclast'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "Culture: The Triskelion Flame; Thaumaturgy"}]

name: Kira, Servant of Garukhan
summary: Maraketh warrior who leads a dekhara (warband), obsessed with Garukhan, the 'Vulture of the Wastes'. She kidnaps Sekhema Oyun to sacrifice her, hoping to become a 'Red Sekhema' and wearing the Sekhema Feather; the exile kills her and Garukhan but fails to save Oyun.

name: Commander Kirac
summary: Tracker and officer of Oriath's volunteer Citizen Vanguard, later Commander; younger brother of Baran. In legacy epilogue quests he asked the Exile to find Baran, who had fallen in with 'radical' Zana Caeserius. Sits in the Karui Shores War Room, issues maps, pinnacle invitations and Atlas Books of Skill, calls the Exile 'Godslayer' and backs the Maven as 'the best of our terrible options'. Took Sirus's blow meant for Zana. His dialogue says the Maven resurrects Baran for her games.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_picking_up_the_pieces", "locator": "Kirac dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_a_call_to_arms", "locator": "Karui Shores: Helena directs the player to Commander Kirac in the War Room, who gives a Tier 1 map"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_a_call_to_arms", "locator": "objective: commissioned by Kirac"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "Sirus: 'Kirac was Baran's brother'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_atlas_book_of_skill", "locator": "obtained from Kirac or Eagon"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_picking_up_the_pieces", "locator": "quote: 'My younger brother, Baran, fell in with a radical by the name of Zana Caeserius'"}, {"source_id": "src_poedb_commander_kirac", "locator": "KiracOnBaranResurrectionTwo; Introduction: 'tracker and officer in Oriath's new Citizen Vanguard'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_searing_exarch_quest", "locator": "Kirac: 'She's the best of our terrible options'"}]

name: Kishara
summary: Vaal explorer from Atziri's time who fell out of favour; Atziri seized her ship and sacrificed its crew. She hid Kishara's Star near the Causeway and her descendants formed the Brinerot clan.

name: Kole
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "Act 3 (c. Piety's experiments; relative date unknown)", "story_order": null}
summary: Unique demon monster in The Lunaris Temple Level 1 (Act 3), with a high-damage Ground Smash and a chain pull. Per the wiki's lore section (attributed to Grigor), Kole was an Oriathan rapist whom Piety used in her experiments. A stronger Carnage variant appeared in the Tower Map (2.4.0-3.1.0).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_kole", "locator": "Infobox: location = The Lunaris Temple Level 1 (Act 3); Lore: 'According to Grigor, Kole was an Oriathan ... before Piety used him in her experiments'"}]

name: Korell Goya
summary: Syndicate member from the Redblade warband. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Kraityn
summary: Bandit lord of the Broken Bridge, exiled from Theopolis in 1598 IC for avarice, larceny, murder and more (Letters of Exile).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_kraityn", "locator": "Lore: Letters of Exile"}, {"source_id": "src_ingame_kraityn", "locator": "Lore: Letters of Exile"}]

name: Krutog, Lord of Kin
summary: Kin Tyrant boss of the Volcanic Warrens on the Isle of Kin, killed in Land of the Kin.

name: K'Tash, the Hate Shepherd
summary: Scourge boss (K'tash, the Hate Shepherd) that can spawn in the Nightmare realm depending on the monsters present; the wiki gives stats but no individual lore.

name: Kurai
summary: Administrator of the Rogue Harbour; starts the introductory Rogue Harbour quest in Act 6 and hands out the first contract.

name: Kurgal, the Blackblooded
summary: Abyssal Lich, commander of the Lightless and servant of Kulemak. Boss in the Lich's Tomb in Delve (depth 90+); born from a stone golem Kulemak created in his bargain with Aul.

name: Kylian Cyaxan
summary: Founder of House Cyaxan, one of the four Great Founders who rebelled against Emperor Tyndarus Phrecius.

name: Lachlann of Endless Lament
summary: Lachlann the Lost, a Count of the Cemetery of the Eternals seeking to reunite with his family; the Exile puts him to rest after the Memorial Gate opens.

name: Lani
summary: Leader of the rebel encampment at Overseer's Tower (Act 5) and hub NPC of the Oriath Docks in Act 10; she tells how Vilenta betrayed her and Bannon, is fond of Bannon, and rewards the exile after Kitava's fall.

name: Lavianga
summary: Karui scholar-advisor to Kaom.

name: Lazhwar
summary: Archbishop of the Eternal Faith whose thaumaturgy and Eternal Laboratory work preceded Malachai's.

name: Leitis
summary: Ogham prisoner held by the Executioner; freed by the Exile, and sends the Exile after Count Geonor.

name: Leo, Master of the Arena
summary: Pit master of the Sarn arena; forsaken master of PvP missions. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Lilly Roth
summary: Pirate captain and granddaughter of Weylam Roth; her ship brings the exile to Lioneye's Watch (Act 6) and back to Oriath (Act 10). She is the gem vendor, asks the exile to clear the Twilight Strand, to retrieve The Teardrop (map to Tsoatha) and, after Kitava's death, offers to sail the exile away.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_ravenous_god", "locator": "Lilly Roth dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_ingame_the_ravenous_god", "locator": "Lilly Roth dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_act_6", "locator": "NPCs"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_recurring_nightmare", "locator": "Lilly offers to ferry exile to Oriath"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_toward_the_future", "locator": "Lilly dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_fallen_from_grace", "locator": "Lilly: drowned Oriathans washing ashore after cultists plunder refugee ships"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_map_to_tsoatha", "locator": "Lilly: Templar privateers took the Teardrop; she and her grandfather plan to sail to Tsoatha"}]

name: Missionary Lorandis
summary: Twilight Order preacher in Kingsmarch who sends the Exile to Arastas to take an oath to the Saviour and later leads them to the Herald; cries 'We were trying to... save you' when the ambush turns.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_utopia", "locator": "quest description"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Follow the Preacher; Survive the ambush"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_utopia", "locator": "start: Speak to Missionary Lorandis"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Follow the Preacher / Survive the ambush"}]

name: Lorrata
summary: Giant tree over the Vaal Ruins in the Wetlands, said to be the oldest tree in the area and planted by ancient Azmeri travellers (per Eramir); its roots held the Vaal doors shut until poisoned by the Exile with Maligaro's Spike and the Baleful Gem.

name: Lucan Octavius
summary: Wealthy Oriathan alchemist, Tane's master; publicly genial but violent and lustful in private; killed by Tane, who was exiled for it.

name: Lumerius
summary: Son of the Countess; datamine lists him as an Act 5 boss in Oriath. Role unverified.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_countess", "locator": "para 2"}, {"source_id": "src_web_poe2db_act5", "locator": "Bosses Listed"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_countess", "locator": "paragraph 2: 'She also has a son named Lumerius'"}]

name: Lundara
summary: Twin sister Sekhema; possibly Lunaris.

name: Lycia, Herald of the Scourge
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "lived sometime after the Eternal Empire's founding; exact date unknown (video guesses c. 1000-1300 IC)", "story_order": null}
summary: Former Templar scholar and keeper of forbidden knowledge who, disillusioned by the truth of Innocence's origins and the Templars' unmarked ossuary bones, made a pact with the Scourge demon Beidat for immortality; imprisoned in the Sanctum she is its fourth-floor boss and league antagonist.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_sin", "locator": "'Original Sin'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_lycia_herald_of_the_scourge", "locator": "page summary: former Templar, necromancy and lithomancy, immortality in pact with Beidat"}, {"source_id": "src_yt_7QuY96FyhG4", "locator": "[9:39]-[11:30] pact; [11:32]-[11:50] boss phases"}]

name: Maata
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead", "story_order": null}
summary: Chieftain of the Tawhoa tribe; her text discusses the Vaal.

name: Makoru
summary: Captain of the Aurora May under the Meridian Free Traders; ferries the Exile around Ngamakanui and gives the logbook.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Makoru quote"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Makoru: Captain of the Aurora May"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_grand_expedition", "locator": "Take Makoru's Logbook"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Talk to Makoru; Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon"}]

name: Malachai
aliases: ["Father of Dreams", "Laureate Thaumaturge", "Malachai", "Malachai, The Nightmare", "Malachai, the Nightmare", "The Nightmare"]
summary: Laureate Thaumaturge to Chitus, creator of the gemling legions and Rapture Device. Spared by Voll, he entered the Beast and caused the Cataclysm. Defeated by the exile in Act 4.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "'Malachai'; 'Reign of Voll'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_malachai_the_nightmare", "locator": "lead"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "intro paragraph 5 and section 'The Cataclysm (~1339 IC)'; 'Reign of Voll'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_malachai_the_nightmare", "locator": "Lore"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_depraved_trinity", "locator": "Three lieutenants of Malachai"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "Chitus: Malachai"}]

name: Maligaro
summary: Inquisitor Maligaro, flesh artist of the Godless Three; burned by Voll, his spirit lived on in Maligaro's Sanctum; killed in Act 7.

name: Maramoa
summary: Karui exile from Ngamakanui (sentenced 1597 IC) who survives in the Sarn Encampment; he appears in Acts 3 and 8. In Act 8 he warns of the Gemling Legion and of the awakened Solaris and Lunaris, and sends the exile to take the Sun and Moon Orbs from their devotees.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_lost_in_love", "locator": "Walkthrough"}, {"source_id": "src_ingame_lost_in_love", "locator": "Walkthrough"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_gemling_legion", "locator": "Maramoa"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_lunar_eclipse", "locator": "Maramoa"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_letters_of_exile", "locator": "'Maramoa of Ngamakanui', Sentenced 1597 IC"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_act_3", "locator": "Act 3 NPC list includes Maramoa"}]

name: General Marceus Lioneye
summary: Eternal Empire general and leader of the Gemling Legion; archer with a virtue gem in one eye; defeated by Hyrri's ambush at Lioneye's Watch during the Purity Rebellion. (General of the Eternal Empire legion in Legion league, 3.7.0.)
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "'Lioneye's Watch'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_general_marceus_lioneye", "locator": "lead + Lore"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_general_marceus_lioneye", "locator": "Lore"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_king_kaom", "locator": "Purity Rebellion: Kaom wore his head on his belt"}]

name: Marylene
summary: Victario's lover, died shielding him at the Grain Gate.

name: Matiki
summary: Karui held on one of the Act 4 islands (rotating location) whose rescue unlocks the Eye of Hinekora and Trial of the Ancestors.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_trial_of_the_ancestors_quest_", "locator": "quest log 'Meet up with Matiki'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_act_4", "locator": "Progression"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_act_4", "locator": "Progression and Matiki table"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_trial_of_the_ancestors_quest", "locator": "Meet up with Matiki"}]

name: The Maven
summary: Primordial claimant of the Atlas who is 'bored with the realm she has given', serving only her own amusement; not the Elder but to be feared. She witnesses map bosses and traps challengers in her Memory Game. Her origin is unresolved.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_decay", "locator": "Envoy: 'She is not The Elder, but you are right to fear her.'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_maven_s_game", "locator": "Quest"}]

name: Maxarius
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "ancient, when the Azmeri still lived in the Azmerian mountains", "story_order": null}
summary: Per the Sanctum relic texts (as recounted in the wiki and video), Maxarius, the first High Templar, was in truth Innocence himself - a charlatan who stole the Descry symbol from fire-terrified newcomers, used their fear, and vilified his brother Sin to ascend.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_yt_7QuY96FyhG4", "locator": "[28:00]-[30:30] relics reveal Maxarius = Innocence; quote 'a charlatan, a liar and a power seeker'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "===Templar history (line ~188): \"The very first High Templar, Maxarius, was not Innocence's chosen, as was told, but Innocence himself.\""}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_innocence", "locator": "Lore: \"He posed himself as Maxarius, the first High Templar, and vilified his own brother as the Original Evil.\""}]

name: Medici Perandus
summary: Member of the Perandus family styled 'Prefect to the Treasury'. The corpus knows him only from the flavour text of the Perandus Signet; no dated action is recorded, so his era is unknown.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_perandus_family", "locator": "section '===Medici Perandus===': 'Medici Perandus, \"Prefect to the Treasury\", is a member of the Perandus family only referred to by the flavour text of Perandus Signet.'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "section '==Members==' > Perandus family: 'Medici Perandus, Prefect to the Treasury'"}]

name: Medved
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "Expedition era, thousands of years before PoE1", "story_order": null}
summary: Leader of the Druids of the Broken Circle who claimed to peer into the past. He pioneered culling a horror species, challenged the horrors' leader alone and vanished. He returns as a horror boss in PoE1 (Medved, Feller of Heroes).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "Colonisation; Medved's challenge"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "Society + Thaumaturgy"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "section 'The Kalguur' (Broken Circle, Priesthood, Medved's challenge)"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "Notable members: Historical"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_grand_expedition", "locator": "Defeat Medved, the Fallen Seer"}, {"source_id": "src_web_pcgamesn_return_of_the_ancients", "locator": "Medved"}]

name: Meginord
summary: Figure referred to only in flavour text and names of unique belts (e.g. Meginord's Girdle, Meginord's Vise). The wiki says he ruled a northern part of Wraeclast, but it is unclear whether he is a person or a naming pun.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_meginord", "locator": "Intro: 'a figure only mentioned in the flavour text and names of unique items'; Lore: 'it is unclear whether the character was intended to be called north-north'"}]

name: Mektul, the Forgemaster
summary: Boss of The Molten Vault in Act 3, defeated in the Treasures of Utzaal quest; drops The Hammer of Kamasa.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_treasures_of_utzaal", "locator": "Quest log '===Defeat Mektul, the Forgemaster===' and '===Pick up The Hammer of Kamasa==='"}]

name: Merveil, the Siren
summary: Former court beauty of Sarn who married the swordsman Daresso; the cursed Star of Wraeclast he gave her transformed her into a siren-like monster who bore monstrous children; Act 1 final boss (Cavern of Anger / Merveil's Lair).

name: Mortimer
summary: Clearfell Encampment resident who warns the Exile about ancient creatures beneath the surface and asks the Exile to cave in the cracks and whatever they find (PoE2 Act 1, Cracks in the Earth, removed quest).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_cracks_in_the_earth", "locator": "Walkthrough: Mortimer dialogue, '===Return to Mortimer===' and '===Quest Complete===' section"}]

name: Mother Gull
summary: Figure who pitied Great Fire survivors and gave them grain and water that was tainted, causing cannibalism.

name: Nashta, the Usurper
summary: Maraketh warrior and sister of Adiyah who tried to start a civil war in the Maraketh by stealing Solerai's Spear and attacking caravans; the exile and Adiyah kill her in the final contract.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_adiyah_the_wayfinder", "locator": "Lore: sister Nashta, Solerai's Spear, Contract: Heart of Glory"}]

name: Nasima
summary: Listed among the Maraketh's notable members (the list gives the name without a Sekhema title); one of the three akhara named on the Brutal Restraint Timeless Jewel. The corpus holds only list-level mentions, so details are limited.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_maraketh", "locator": "Notable members list: '* [[Nasima]]' under the Maraketh section"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_brutal_restraint", "locator": "Variant table: 'Nasima' with 'Denoted service of # dekhara in the akhara of Nasima'"}]

name: Navali, Speaker of Hinekora
summary: Karui seer who guides the Exile through the Halls of the Dead and presents them to the Mother of Death. Also appeared in PoE1 (Prophecy, Ancestor).

name: Navira
summary: The water Djinn bound to serve the Sekhema Varashta as penance; an invulnerable minion of the Disciple of Varashta ascendancy that stays inert in its barya until commanded.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_disciple_of_varashta", "locator": "section 'Overview': 'The three Djinns are Ruzhan the fire Djinn, Navira the water Djinn, and Kelari the assassin Djinn.'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_disciple_of_varashta", "locator": "section 'Overview': 'Each the Djinn are invulnerable minions that remain inert in their Baryas until the Disciple commands them to unleash their powers.'"}]

name: The Neglected Flame
summary: Memory boss guarding the thread that leads to the Incarnation of Neglect; Eagon siphons its kernel.

name: Nenet
summary: Faridun rogue (the Scout) hireable for Perception jobs. Unlocked by a Tullina contract. Her questline was never released in-game: it would have had the exile seek the Book of Jamanra to prove the Jamanra existed.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_nenet_the_scout", "locator": "Lead; \"To unlock Nenet, run a contract with Tullina\"; questline note"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "'Jamanra' section: 'Nenet, a Faridun, tasked the exile with finding the Book of Jamanra'"}]

name: Nessa
summary: Healer and vendor at Lioneye's Watch, taught Brutus's tale in Theopolis schools; gives Mercy Mission, Siren's Cadence.

name: Niko the Mad
summary: Master-NPC miner who guides the Exile into the Azurite Mine; collects Voltaxic Sulphite to power his Crawler (a repurposed Eternal torture device) and generator.

name: Niles
summary: Former Templar interrogator, hireable rogue in the Rogue Harbour (Counter-thaumaturgy). Unlocked by a Huck contract; his contract unlocks Vinderi.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_niles_the_interrogator", "locator": "Lead and Lore: \"He is the former interrogator of the Templar\"; \"To unlock Niles, run a contract with Huck\")"}]

name: Oak
summary: Bandit lord of the Wetlands; preaches peace ('To spare the lives of many, you need take only one'), fights Alira's thralls; wears Oak's Amulet, one of three pieces of the Apex.

name: Olroth
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "Expedition era, thousands of years before PoE1", "story_order": null}
summary: Leader of the Knights of the Sun, called the Gallant and later the Grim. Recorded the Empty-Eyed Fiend's killing of a young woman, fought the Fiend with a gem, was stabbed by priests, and returned as the undying horror the exile fights as the Expedition league boss.

name: Lord Mayor Ondar
summary: Mayor of Sarn who, with gems implanted for the occasion, betrayed and killed Emperor Chitus during the Night of a Thousand Ribbons celebration, during the Purity Rebellion (1334 IC).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "'Assassination of Chitus'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "section 'Assassination of Chitus' and 'Night of a Thousand Ribbons'"}]

name: Orbala
summary: Maraketh warrior, known as the Sekhema of Sekhemas, who fought the 'bandit king of Stridevolf'; PoE2 shows she was the mortal identity of Garukhan before her ascension. That she was also the traveller who freed Sin from Innocence's worshippers is only suggested by relic lore (inferred).

name: Oshabi, Avatar of the Grove
summary: Boss form of Oshabi. It is triggered in a Map Device by a Sacred Blossom map fragment; the Heart of the Grove, grown from a harvested Tier 4 seed, is the separate challenge that leads to the Avatar of the Grove.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_oshabi", "locator": "lead; Dialogue: Introduction, The Grove, Lifeforce, Exile from the Azmeri"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_oshabi", "locator": "lead paragraph"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_harvest_league", "locator": "League mechanic: Heart of the Grove"}]

name: Oswald
summary: Treasure-hunter Quartermaster of the Ziggurat Encampment who buys salvage and shipping for Kingsmarch.

name: Overseer Krow
summary: Slave Pens overseer boss blocking access to Overseer's Tower.

name: Oyun
summary: Maraketh akhara leader at Highgate; recounts Deshret's sealing of the Beast.

name: Petarus and Vanja
summary: Relic-hunter duo of Highgate who seek Garukhan's Storm Blade and bottle its storm.

name: Phanos, Last Disciple of Auria
summary: Named in Act 5 datamine as a boss/text-audio entry. Unreleased; no lore available.

name: Phya, Sentinel of the Cradle
summary: Guardian boss of the Matriarch Halls in the Precursor Fortress; yields the Origin Cradle.

name: Phyx, Sentinel of the Spark
summary: Guardian boss of the Patriarch Halls in the Precursor Fortress; yields the Origin Spark.

name: Piety of Theopolis
summary: Former Vinia of Oriath, pardoned by Dominus; thaumaturge making miscreations in Sarn; saved by Malachai; becomes an Abomination in Act 4; eventually killed by Malachai.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_piety", "locator": "Lore: Background and In Path of Exile"}, {"source_id": "src_ingame_piety", "locator": "Lore: Background and In Path of Exile"}]

name: Putembo
summary: Tyrant of the primeval civilisation who forced subjects to quarry stone for his fortress; overthrown by Aul.

name: Qianga
summary: Named on a Gilded Shaper Scarab as the 'Deliverer of the Sealing Blade to the Watchers'; probably an Order of the Djinn member (wiki says unclear).

name: Queen in the Mists
summary: New Ritual boss in 0.5, unlocked by an Atlas Tree node.

name: Queen of Filth
summary: Boss in the Apex of Filth in Aggorat, Utzaal (present); the Exile defeats her to obtain the Temple Door Idol that opens the Temple of Kopec.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "Quest 'Defeat the Queen of Filth'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "'Defeat the Queen of Filth'"}]

name: Quilon Bardiya
summary: Founder of House Bardiya, one of the four Great Founders who rebelled against Emperor Tyndarus Phrecius.

name: Rakiata
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead", "story_order": null}
summary: Chieftain of the Tasalio tribe; after her father the chieftain was felled by invaders she took up arms, entrusted a fragment of a fabled spear to the sea, and fights in a dance-like style emulating Tasalio's tide; Ikiaho vouched for her in the Halls.

name: Rakkar, the Frozen Talon
summary: Rakkar, the Frozen Talon is a boss the Exile defeats in the Glacial Tarn on the way up Mount Kriar during the Recruit the Vaal interlude.

name: Ratha Azadi
summary: Founder of House Azadi, one of the four Great Founders who rebelled against Emperor Tyndarus Phrecius.

name: Rathbreaker
summary: Sun Clan leader of the hyenic raiders harassing the trade route that blocks the Ardura caravan; the Exile's first Act 2 boss.

name: Raulf, the Recruiter
summary: Meridian Free Traders agent who recruits labourers and specialists for Kingsmarch; refuses to be anyone's spy.

name: Raulo (Fidelitas)
summary: Maligaro's slave and lover, injected with Calibric Extantia and renamed Fidelitas.

name: Renly
summary: Clearfell blacksmith who rewards the Exile for slaying the Bloated Miller and forges the Rune Spikes from the Red Vale runes.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_reaching_clearfell", "locator": "Walkthrough 'Talk to the Blacksmith'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_secrets_in_the_dark", "locator": "Walkthrough 'Bring the Runes to Renly'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_ezomytes", "locator": "Speak to Renly"}]

name: Ridan, Afarud Commander
summary: Afarud boss in mirages; drops The Black Barya.

name: Rigwald, the Wolven King
summary: Ezomyte thane of Ezomyr who received Victario's letters seeking aid for the Purity Rebellion; possessed by the Greatwolf during the Rebellion. Boss of the Talisman league; his memoirs are the Inscription lore found at Stone Altars. NOT a member of the Immortal Syndicate (the Betrayal video only notes Thane Jorgin shares the title 'thane' with him).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "'Bloody Flowers Rebellion'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_ezomytes", "locator": "'Rigwald'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_talisman_league", "locator": "Rigwald, the Wolven King: boss of the Talisman league"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_first_ones", "locator": "The Greatwolf: Rigwald possessed during the Purity Rebellion"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_inscription", "locator": "memoirs of Thane Rigwald"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_victario", "locator": "Victario wrote letters to Thane Rigwald of Ezomyr"}]

name: Riker Maloney
summary: Syndicate member without established background. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Rin Yuushu
summary: Syndicate member from the Mutewind warband. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

name: Risu
summary: Faridun defector freed at Mawdun Quarry who reveals Jamanra's plans, the Halani Gates closure, and Traitor's Passage.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_trail_of_corruption_act_2", "locator": "Quest log 'Question the Faridun Defector' / 'Talk to Risu'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_faridun", "locator": "Overview"}]

name: Rog, the Disenchanter
summary: Kalguuran dealer who runs the Kingsmarch disenchanting apothecary and dreams of his own shop; manages the group's tabletop game; former rebel.

name: Romira Phrecian
summary: Emperor who fed his wife's sons (fathered by his brother) back to her; deposed in the Night of a Thousand Ribbons.

name: Royal Blood Priest
summary: Unique monster (variant of Zolin, Blood Priest) found in a Sacrificial Chamber room of Atziri's Temple. The page gives no lore text. Introduced in 0.4.0.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_royal_blood_priest", "locator": "infobox (location 'Atziri's Temple'); lead 'found in Atziri's Temple in a Sacrificial Chamber room... a variant of Zolin, Blood Priest'"}]

name: Royal Colossus
summary: Unique monster (full name 'X, Royal Colossus') that can be randomly summoned by an Ancient Beacon. Known abilities: Slam Combo and Charged Slam (lightning). Introduced in 0.4.0. The page gives no lore text.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_royal_colossus", "locator": "infobox (location 'Spawned by an Ancient Beacon'); Abilities list; Version history 0.4.0"}]

name: Royal Commander
summary: Unique monster (variant of Blackjaw, the Remnant) found in a Commander room of Atziri's Temple. The page lists no abilities and gives no lore text. Introduced in 0.4.0.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_royal_commander", "locator": "infobox (location 'Atziri's Temple'); lead 'found in Atziri's Temple in a Commander room... a variant of Blackjaw, the Remnant'"}]

name: Royal Sentinel
summary: Unique monster (variant of Stone Sentinel) that can be randomly summoned by an Ancient Beacon. Known abilities: Fist Slam, Charged Fist Slam and Charged Foot Slam, the last two converting physical damage to lightning. Introduced in 0.4.0. The page gives no lore text.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_royal_sentinel", "locator": "infobox (location 'Spawned by an Ancient Beacon'); lead 'It is a variant of Stone Sentinel'; Abilities list"}]

name: Royal Spy Master
summary: Unique monster found in a Spymaster room of Atziri's Temple. The page lists no abilities and gives no lore text. Introduced in 0.4.0.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_royal_spy_master", "locator": "infobox (location 'Atziri's Temple'); lead 'found in Atziri's Temple in a Spymaster room'"}]

name: Rudja, the Dread Engineer
summary: Faridun engineer guarding Mawdun Mine's abandoned foundry.

name: Ruzhan
summary: The fire Djinn bound to serve the Sekhema Varashta as penance; an invulnerable minion of the Disciple of Varashta ascendancy that stays inert in its barya until commanded.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_disciple_of_varashta", "locator": "section 'Overview': 'The three Djinns are Ruzhan the fire Djinn, Navira the water Djinn, and Kelari the assassin Djinn.'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_disciple_of_varashta", "locator": "section 'Overview': 'Each the Djinn are invulnerable minions that remain inert in their Baryas until the Disciple commands them to unleash their powers.'"}]

name: Cardinal Sanctus Vox
summary: Oriathan noble, ancestor of the Vox family; general of the Templar legion.

name: Saresh
aliases: ["Saresh", "Saresh, Necromancer of the Weeping Black", "Saresh, of the Weeping Black", "Surgeon of the Dead"]
summary: Faridun reject and necromancer of Weeping Black, former Order of the Djinn member; defeated by Garukhan (Orbala) with the Horn of the Vastiri.

name: Sasan, the Bandit Lord
summary: Bandit Lord who takes Atlas Runners hostage while they map; defeat him or pay 50,000 Gold; drops The Living Blade and The Bandit Lord's Band.

name: Scourge of the Skies
summary: Unique boss of Shrike Island in Act 4, killed to complete the Shrike Island quest.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_shrike_island_quest", "locator": "Infobox completion and quest log '===Kill the Scourge of the Skies==='"}]

name: Servi
summary: Tribal guide who warns the Exile of a forsaken ruin in the dark where Soul Cores may be found; the Azmeri-descent and Azak/Orok politics claims are not supported by the corpus and were removed.

name: Servitor Marius
summary: Twilight Order servitor on Arastas who offers the Exile membership in the Utopia or a donation; refusal completes the Utopia quest.

name: Shambrin
summary: Maraketh dekhara who asks the Exile to search Deshar for the corpse of a woman she cared about, Lailuma.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_trail_of_corruption_act_2", "locator": "Quest log 'Use the Desert Map to travel to Traitor's Passage'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_trail_of_corruption_act_2", "locator": "Quest log 'Speak to Shambrin' (Tradition's Toll)"}]

name: The Shaper
summary: Valdo Caeserius reduced by the Elder's memory-feeding to a shell who 'shapes' worlds in the Atlas and no longer recognises Zana. Guarded by four Guardians of the Void; pinnacle boss in the Shaper's Realm.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_shaper_quest", "locator": "Memory of Awakening: 'I will forge a world anew'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "Zana: 'the Shaper was in reality Zana's father, Valdo'"}]

name: Shavronne of Umbra
summary: One of Malachai's 'Godless Three'; her returned spirit is killed in Shavronne's Tower so Sin can harvest her soul.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "'Axiom Prison'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_shavronne_of_umbra", "locator": "History; In-game encounters"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_essence_of_umbra", "locator": "Walkthrough"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_depraved_trinity", "locator": "Three lieutenants of Malachai"}]

name: Silk
summary: Storyteller/artist of the Forest Encampment (Sin notes many Azmeri-descended artists worship Arakaali) who falls for Arakaali in Act 7, calls her his bride and is lost when the exile kills her. Earlier he asks the exile for Black Venom from Maligaro's pet spider (Web of Secrets).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_sharp_and_cruel", "locator": "Silk dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_ingame_sharp_and_cruel", "locator": "Silk dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_mother_of_spiders", "locator": "Walkthrough"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_act_7", "locator": "intro"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_web_of_secrets", "locator": "Silk asks for venom from Black Death, Maligaro's pet spider"}]

name: Siora, Blade of the Mists
summary: Siora, Blade of the Mists is a boss the Exile defeats at the altar during the Recruit the Ezomytes interlude.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_ezomytes", "locator": "Quest log, 'Defeat Siora, Blade of the Mists.' (Siora: 'Darkness descends... and with it, your end!')"}]

name: Siosa
summary: Ghost in the Library, friend of Icius Perandus, gem vendor after A Fixture of Fate.

name: Sirus, Awakener of Worlds
summary: Smuggler and leader of the Elderslayers who loved Zana; sacrificed himself into the Arcana trap and returned empty and mad. He burned Oriath and is a pinnacle boss; journals narrate his fall.

name: Sister Cassia
summary: Former Templar-circle mechanical artisan and Blight NPC who runs the Purification Pump encounters and the Anoint bench; exiled by High Templar Dominus for subverting his virtue-gem projects, and replaced by Piety. Believes Blighted maps lead to the Blight's source.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_sister_cassia", "locator": "lead; Dialogue: Exile, Replacement, Devices, Fungi, Blighted Maps"}]

name: Solerai
summary: Legendary Maraketh Sekhema who with Lundara ended the Winter of the World; possibly Solaris.

name: Sonja, the Farmer
summary: Kingsmarch farmer puzzled by the thriving plants on supposedly barren soil.

name: Stormgore
summary: Stormgore is a boss the Exile defeats in the Etched Ravine on Mount Kriar during the Recruit the Vaal interlude.

name: Sumei
summary: Historical Maraketh Order of the Djinn 'Master Lorekeeper' who investigated artefact duplication caused by Kalandra's influence.

name: Tacati, Architect of Toxins
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "2000 years before PoE1 (Incursion time travel)", "story_order": null}
summary: Unique Architect found in the Poison Garden, Cultivar Chamber and Toxic Grove rooms of the Temple of Atzoatl; his name gives the legacy Tacati item mods.

name: Tane Octavius
summary: Freed slave and alchemist exiled for killing his abusive master Lucan Octavius; works from an underground laboratory (Karui Shores) to isolate 'intrinsic darkness' from the flesh of monsters via Metamorphs, hoping to purify a cruel soul.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_tane_octavius", "locator": "lead; Dialogue: Tane's Master, Exile, Vision, Goals"}]

name: Tangmazu, the Raven Trickster
summary: Trickster god, brother of Ralakesh, who tricked Solaris into believing Lunaris had betrayed her (PoE1 lore: Strange Voice in Delirium). In PoE2 0.5 he is the Raven Trickster whose defeat completes Strange Reflection and the Delirium storyline.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_strange_reflection", "locator": "completion: Defeat The Raven Trickster"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_god", "locator": "Tangmazu: trickster god, Ralakesh's brother, Delirium NPC, also Tekaru / the Black Crow"}, {"source_id": "src_web_gamedeveloper_return_of_the_ancients", "locator": "Tangmazu, the Raven Trickster"}]

name: Tarcus Veruso
summary: Azmeri leader and first Emperor (Prima Imperialus) who led 80,000 Azmeri to found Sarn in 1 IC. A ruthless despot, he outlawed thaumaturgy, buried the gems under Highgate, and created the legion system.

name: Tarkleigh
summary: Veteran exile and smuggler at Lioneye's Watch; weapon and armour vendor who gives out quests and skill gems; mentions Dominus took the exiles' history.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_tarkleigh", "locator": "Enemy at the Gate quest dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_ingame_tarkleigh", "locator": "Enemy at the Gate quest dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_act_6", "locator": "NPCs"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_brine_king_quest", "locator": "Tarkleigh on Nessa"}]

name: Tasgul, Swallower of Light
summary: Abyssal boss said by guides to drop Kulemak's Invitation (shared with Vandroth); the unlock path to the Vessel of Kulemak.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_web_timesaver_pinnacle_bosses", "locator": "Abyssal Commanders Tasgul and Vandroth drop Kulemak Invitation"}]

name: Tasuni
summary: Maraketh seer at Highgate who hears Deshret's spirit.

name: Tavakai, the Chieftain
summary: Chieftain of the Karui Tukohama Tribe and Act 4 boss. After the weapon is reforged he steals it and flees to Ngakanu with his daughter Makoru, falls to Blood Fever, claims to be the true 'Ngakuramakoi', is rejected by Tukohama, is defeated, then cured by Sin and pledges the Karui to the war against Oriana.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Defeat Tavakai; Witness the Hooded One"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_environmental_lore", "locator": "Tavakai's Declaration"}]

name: Tawhanuku
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead", "story_order": null}
summary: Chieftain of the Hinekora tribe in the Karui Ancestor roster.

name: Tecrod
summary: 'The Hated Slave': Abyssal Lich Lord who, unlike Amanamu, Kurgal and Ulaman, acts independently of Kulemak (PoE1 wiki: forsaken by Kulemak for unclear reasons). In PoE2 (Legacy of the Precursors) he steals the Flame Seed on his wyrm, seeks Kulemak's favour, hunts for the Edicts and is destroyed by the Arbiter of Divinity.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_lightless", "locator": "Abyssal Liches: Tecrod"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_tecrod", "locator": "page"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_tecrod", "locator": "Lore: independent of Kulemak; steals Flame Seed; destroyed by Arbiter of Divinity"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_tecrod", "locator": "Lore"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_lightless", "locator": "Lich Lords: Tecrod, the disgraced Abyssal Lich, forsaken by Kulemak; freed from a Precursor sarcophagus, seeks to win back Kulemak favour"}]

name: Queen Tetzlapokal
summary: Pre-Atziri Vaal queen, devotee of Arakaali with a fascination with death and corpses; the Vaal City rose to prominence in her reign.

name: Thane Jorgin
summary: Syndicate member (Betrayal, 3.5.0) who left as a mere after being accused of killing his brother; believes Rin or another Brotherhood of Silence member responsible (per video). Video notes he shares the title 'thane' with Rigwald; Jun mocks his 'first ones' (Ezomyte) background.

name: Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth
summary: Ezomyte rulers of Holten driven mad into bloodletting and torture; killed by the Exile. Cause attributed to a 'Nameless' darkness far older than Corruption (Hooded One).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_ezomytes", "locator": "Renly; Hooded One; Defeat the Thane and Lady"}]

name: The Arbiter of Ash
aliases: ["Arbiter of Ash", "Guardian of the Flame Seed"]
summary: Guardian of the Flame Seed, created by the Precursors (PoE wiki, History of Wraeclast; the PoE2 wiki says the Unblinking Eye most likely subjugated it originally, which is speculative). Sealed at the Burning Monolith; fought by the Exile as PoE2's first Atlas pinnacle (0.1-0.4) and as a Fortress quest boss in 0.5, after which a wyrm-rider (Tecrod) steals the Flame Seed. Little else is known.

summary: Boss atop the Origin Tower, fought after the Origin Core is placed; it destroys Tecrod's body ('Your kind shall never ordain the First Edict!') and ends the threat of the First Edict. The wiki does not say what it is (the 'apex of the Origins of Divinity storyline' framing comes from guides); 0.5.4 patches later adjusted the fight.

name: The Black Knight
summary: Boss guarding Verisium Outcrops in the Starfall Crater (reached via map ore deposits); drops Svalinn.

name: The Bloated Miller
summary: Diseased former human who terrorises the logging camp; the Exile's first boss.

name: The Boss of the Ring
summary: The unnamed 'Boss' who leads the Ring, per Kurai's dialogue ('the Boss has no tolerance for guests who do not obey his rules'). Identity is not established in the wiki; any name is fan theory.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_kurai_the_administrator", "locator": "'The Ring' dialogue: 'The Boss would like to offer you the opportunity'"}]

name: The Countess (Oriana)
summary: Leader of the Twilight Order and antagonist of PoE2, who took the Seed of Corruption to create a new Beast. Escapes the Exile repeatedly during Acts 1-2; her son Lumerius is named in the wiki.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_countess", "locator": "Summary"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_trail_of_corruption_act_2", "locator": "Quest log 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination'"}, {"source_id": "src_web_poe2db_act5", "locator": "Bosses Listed"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Kanu reveals Oriath"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_countess", "locator": "intro"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Confront Kanu and the First Herald"}]

name: The Dreamer
summary: Keepers-league NPC (full name: Chayula, the Benevolent Dreamer / the One Who Dreamt) found hidden in the Monastery of the Keepers. After the failed fusion of the five Breachlords he was torn asunder and cast into the void; he gave Ailith visions and the Genesis Tree as weapon against the Hiveborn, calls the Exile an ally 'for now', and destroys Ailith's body when she learns the truth (she is a preserved Hiveborn copy).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_dreamer_npc_", "locator": "Dialogue (\"Who are you?\", \"Who is our enemy?\", Enter Back Room) and Lore"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_word_of_the_dreamer", "locator": "Visions V: the Four have become One; Genesis Tree is his gift"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_dreamer", "locator": "Lore: Chayula spoke to humans through dreams, founding the Keepers"}]

name: The Executioner
summary: Ogham executioner who tried to hang the Exile in the opening; killed by the Exile at Ogham Village, freeing Leitis.

name: The High Priest
summary: Act 5 boss in datamine; identity unknown. Unreleased; no lore available.

name: The Hooded One
summary: Unnamed Hooded One bound by a runed sword in the Grelwood's Tree of Souls, later revealed as Sin (Thief of Virtue) who created the Beast; guides the Exile through Acts 1-3.

name: The King in the Mists
aliases: ["King in the Mists", "King of the Nameless"]
summary: Chief of the Nameless shadow creatures in the Viridian Wildwood and enemy of the Maji. Boss of Affliction (PoE1, 3.23) and, in PoE2 Act 1 (Freythorn), the cult 'king' guarding the final Ritual altar. In Legacy of the Maji, Aoife recalls being drawn to him, believing him one of the Maji of old.

name: The Last to Die
summary: Last of the Vaal High Priest bloodline bound by Chaos's pact to the Blood Crucible; appears from the Coast in Scourge, asking the exile to continue in her place; Kalandra says she 'wanders still, forever fleeing, forever burdened by guilt'.

name: Lurking Creature
summary: Abyssal being at the Well of Souls who calls the Exile 'Thief of Virtue! Stealer of Kulemak's spark!', serves whoever holds Kulemak's dominion (Amanamu, Ulaman, Kurgal) but never Tecrod.

name: The Perennial King
summary: Boss of the removed Epilogue quest Ezomyte Infiltration.

name: The Preacher
summary: Act 5 boss in datamine; possibly linked to the Order's preachers like Lorandis (speculation). Unreleased; no lore available.

name: The Prisoner
summary: Being held 'beyond death' in Solitary Confinement by the Eternal Empire; boss and weapon-piece holder. Identity unknown.

name: The Rust King
summary: Guardian of the final Rune of Power in the Red Vale.

name: The Saviour
summary: Figure the Twilight Order's followers swear oaths to and invoke ('For the Saviourrr!', 'Embrace the saviour! Pledge now'); listed first among Order members. Identity/nature not revealed in sources read.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_twilight_order", "locator": "Members: The Saviour"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Benedictus: 'Embrace the saviour! Pledge now.'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_utopia", "locator": "Lorandis encourages oath to 'The Saviour'"}]

name: The Shade
summary: Name Valdo gave the Elder's free-roaming spirit in his dreams; it taught him thaumaturgy and said the Map Device would link the dreamlands to Wraeclast, then asked him to pull the sword (Starforge) from its body.

name: The Trialmaster
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "Captured in the Vaal era; active in PoE1 3.14+ and PoE2 Act 3", "story_order": null}
summary: Servant of Chaos who runs the Trials of Chaos. Introduced in PoE1's Ultimatum league and encountered in PoE2 Act 3 and the endgame Trialmaster arena.
