sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_hilda_s_hunting_quest_", "locator": "Infobox (required: Yes, act 'epilogue', start 'Reach Hilda's Campsite'); quest log '===Defeat the first Great Beast===' and '===Speak to Hilda===' entries (stub page)"}]

name: Hostile Takeover (PoE2 quest)
summary: Ange's Act 4 quest to clear the Shoreline Hideout.

name: Recruit the Ezomytes (Curse of Holten)
summary: Exile kills Isolde, Heldra, Siora, then Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth, ending Holten's blight; Renly pledges all clans to the war.

name: Recruit the Maraketh (The Stolen Barya)
summary: Exile defeats Elzarah, Vornas and Prince Azmadi to save the First Barya; Asala completes the Gifting of Water and brings the Maraketh to Kingsmarch.

name: Recruit the Vaal (Doryani's Contingency)
summary: The code phrase 'the time of the sparrow has come' and defeat of Rakkar, Stormgore, Zolin and Zelina secures the Cuachic.

name: Landing at the Ziggurat Refuge
summary: Siege of Oriath ends not at Oriath but at the Ziggurat Refuge; Quest Complete text says 'despite your attempts to travel to Oriath'. Why is not stated; the Beast's corruption holds the Hooded One in thrall afterwards.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_siege_of_oriath", "locator": "Quest Complete"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_precursors", "locator": "Doryani: Beast's Corruption holds the Hooded One"}]

name: Vessel of Kulemak
summary: Pinnacle Abyss encounter, the Vessel of Kulemak: Kulemak's Invitation (dropped by Abyssal commanders per guides) sends the player into the Well and the Black Cathedral. Guides say defeating it unlocks the Abyssal Lich ascendancy (exact conditions vary by guide/patch); fully empowering it means defeating the Lich Lords Kurgal, Ulaman and Amanamu.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_act_2", "locator": "Black Cathedral / Kulemak's Invitation"}, {"source_id": "src_web_domistae_poe2_endgame_guide", "locator": "pinnacle name 'Vessel of Kulemak' unconfirmed"}, {"source_id": "src_web_timesaver_pinnacle_bosses", "locator": "Vessel of Kulemak: Tasgul and Vandroth drop Kulemak Invitation; empower via Kurgal, Ulaman, Amanamu"}]

name: Land of the Kin (PoE2 quest)
summary: Required Act 4 side quest, begun by speaking to Makoru and sailing to the Isle of Kin; the Exile explores the Isle and Volcanic Warrens to kill Krutog, Lord of Kin. Part of the rotating Act 4 requirements.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_land_of_the_kin", "locator": "Infobox (required: Yes, act 4, start 'Sailing to Isle of Kin', completion 'Kill Krutog, Lord of Kin'); lead; quest log '===Explore the Isle of Kin===' to '===Quest Complete===' "}]

name: Legacy of the Maji (endgame quest)
summary: Endgame quest begun by finding Aoife near a Ritual Altar: she was killed by the King in the Mists (the King of the Nameless); the Exile destroys his effigies, kills him again at the Crux of Nothingness, takes his Head and Aoife's body, performs the Rite of the Nameless over five maps and defeats the Bodach. Quest complete: 'You have defeated The Bodach and Aoife is finally at peace.' (steps from a hidden comment block).

name: Legacy of the Precursors (endgame quest)
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "Immediately after the PoE2 campaign (post-Siege of Oriath)", "story_order": 6001}
aliases: ["Legacy of the Precursors", "Legacy of the Precursors (Epilogue quest)"]
summary: The primary PoE2 endgame quest: the Hooded One sleeps, held in thrall by the Beast's Corruption; Doryani proposes recovering Precursor knowledge via the Waygate, leading to the Precursor Tower, the Fortress, the Burning Monolith, the Arbiter of Ash and (0.5) the Arbiter of Divinity.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_precursors", "locator": "Quest log"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_precursors", "locator": "lead: primary endgame quest obtained immediately upon reaching the endgame; quest log 'Check on the Hooded One' / 'Speak to Doryani'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_precursors", "locator": "Quest log steps 1-147, Quest Complete"}]

name: Ngamahu's Test (PoE2 quest)
summary: Optional Act 4 Test of Mettle in the Halls of the Dead, started at the Hinekora Totem: three waves of enemies, then a Blank Tattoo of Ngamahu is turned in for a permanent choice of +5 Strength or +5% Fire Resistance (cannot be changed).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_ngamahu_s_test", "locator": "Infobox (act 4, optional, start 'Enter Ngamahu's Test in Halls of the Dead'); lead ('one of the three additional Tests of Mettle'); Rewards: 'Strength Tattoo of Ngamahu (+5 Strength) or Fire Tattoo of Ngamahu (+5% Fire Resistance)'"}]

name: The Origin Core and the Origin Tower
summary: Combining the Origin Cradle and Origin Spark (from the Matriarch and Patriarch Halls) in the Precursor Reactor yields the Origin Core; when the Exile places it in the Origin Tower, Tecrod's wyrm incapacitates the Exile and Tecrod exults 'With this, the Master shall know unending power!' before the Arbiter of Divinity destroys his body.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_tecrod", "locator": "Lore: when the player places the Origin Core into the Origin Tower, Tecrod's wyrm incapacitates the character"}, {"source_id": "src_web_domistae_poe2_endgame_guide", "locator": "Matriarch and Patriarch Halls drop Origin Cradle and Origin Spark; combine into Origin Core at the Precursor Reactor"}]

name: The Pinnacle of Flame (removed quest)
summary: Epilogue/endgame quest of 0.1-0.4: find the Burning Monolith on the endgame map and collect three Crisis Fragments to open the door to the Arbiter of Ash. Removed in 0.5.0 and folded into Legacy of the Precursors.

name: The Patriarch and Matriarch Halls
summary: After the Arbiter of Ash falls and the Origin Tower is explored, Doryani sends the Exile to the Patriarch and Matriarch Halls: defeat Phyx, Sentinel of the Spark (Origin Spark) and Phya, Sentinel of the Cradle (Origin Cradle); the two are combined in the Precursor Reactor into the Origin Core. Source steps sit in a hidden comment block of the quest log (medium).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_precursors", "locator": "steps 112-137: 'Defeat Phyx, Sentinel of the Spark', 'Defeat Phya, Sentinel of the Cradle', 'Pick up the Origin Spark/Cradle', 'Activate the Precursor Reactor', 'Pick up the Origin Core'"}]

name: Activating the Precursor Tower
summary: The Exile reaches a Precursor Tower and activates its beacon; an Irradiated Tablet drops and (in 0.5) the Precursor Fortress rises from the ground in a cinematic.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_precursors", "locator": "Activate the Precursor Beacon: 'An Irradiated Tablet will drop, and the Precursor Fortress will rise from the ground in a cinematic.'"}]

name: PoE2 1.0 full release
summary: Announced at Gamescom Opening Night Live (Aug 2026): Path of Exile 2 leaves Early Access on 2026-12-11 with a six-act campaign (Acts 5 and 6 new). Meta/release fact, not an in-world event.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_web_thegamer_poe2_release_date", "locator": "article 2026-08-25: release 11 Dec 2026, six acts"}, {"source_id": "src_web_allthings_poe2_release", "locator": "launch date, Acts 5-6 complete campaign"}]

name: The Runeseeker (PoE2 quest)
summary: Act 4 quest from Farrow: collect Torn Map Pieces for Dannig, unlocking Plunder's Point and Runeforging.

name: Shrike Island (PoE2 quest)
summary: Required Act 4 side quest, begun by speaking to Makoru and sailing to Shrike Island; the Exile explores the island and kills the unique Scourge of the Skies. Part of the rotating Act 4 requirements.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_shrike_island_quest", "locator": "Infobox (required: Yes, act 4, start 'Sailing to Shrike Island', completion 'Kill the Scourge of the Skies'); lead ('secondary main story quest'); '===Kill the Scourge of the Skies==='"}]

name: Siege of Oriath
aliases: ["Siege of Oriath quest", "Siege of Oriath quest (Act 4 finale)"]
summary: Act 4 quest unlocked after the three Interludes: the Hooded One says Wraeclast has united and proposes an assault on Oriath, but the Exile ends up at the Ziggurat Refuge, where the endgame begins.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_siege_of_oriath", "locator": "Walkthrough; infobox act = 4"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_siege_of_oriath", "locator": "Walkthrough"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_siege_of_oriath", "locator": "infobox: completion 'End up at the Ziggurat Refuge'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_vaal", "locator": "Quest Complete: 'If we do manage to stop the Twilight Order and slay the Beast...'"}]

name: Strange Reflection (endgame quest)
summary: Delirium endgame quest started by freeing Elder Madox from a Delirium mirror; leads to the Withered Willow, and ends with defeating the Raven Trickster (Tangmazu).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_strange_reflection", "locator": "infobox: start Find Elder Madox in a map; completion Defeat The Raven Trickster"}]

name: Tasalio's Test (PoE2 quest)
summary: Optional Act 4 Test of Mettle in the Halls of the Dead, started at the Hinekora Totem: three waves of enemies, then a Blank Tattoo of Tasalio is turned in for a permanent choice of +5 Intelligence or +5% Cold Resistance (cannot be changed).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_tasalio_s_test", "locator": "Infobox (act 4, optional, start 'Enter Tasalio's Test in Halls of the Dead'); lead ('one of the three additional Tests of Mettle'); Rewards: 'Intelligence Tattoo of Tasalio (+5 Intelligence) or Cold Tattoo of Tasalio (+5% Cold Resistance)'"}]

name: Tawhoa's Test (PoE2 quest)
summary: Optional Act 4 Test of Mettle in the Halls of the Dead, started at the Hinekora Totem: three waves of enemies, then a Blank Tattoo of Tawhoa is turned in for a permanent choice of +5 Dexterity or +5% Lightning Resistance (cannot be changed).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_tawhoa_s_test", "locator": "Infobox (act 4, optional, start 'Enter Tawhoa's Test in Halls of the Dead'); lead ('one of the three additional Tests of Mettle'); Rewards: 'Dexterity Tattoo of Tawhoa (+5 Dexterity) or Lightning Tattoo of Tawhoa (+5% Lightning Resistance)'"}]

name: The Grand Expedition (quest)
summary: Endgame quest (start: Speak to Farrow): Farrow fears for Kingsmarch; the Exile uses Makoru's logbook to find Gwennen, defeats Medved, the Fallen Seer, Vorana, Last to Fall and Uhtred, the Stardrinker, then searches for Olroth via logbooks passed through Dannig, Tujen and Rog (steps in a hidden comment block). Wiki infobox completion: 'Defeat The Aberration'.

name: The Hunt Begins (PoE2 quest)
summary: Optional Act 1 quest in the Hunting Grounds: Delwyn, an Azmeri hunter, has the Exile track a Spirit wisp to a hunted monster, which introduces the Azmeri Spirit encounter.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_hunt_begins", "locator": "Quest infobox ('act 1', optional); '===Speak to Delwyn===' and '===Quest Complete===' (Version history 0.3.0: 'Azmeri Spirits now start appearing from Hunting Grounds')"}]

name: The Lost Lute (PoE2 quest)
summary: Optional Act 1 quest begun by Una after The Mysterious Shade: the Exile searches Una's family hut in Ogham Farmlands for her carved lute and returns it to her at Clearfell Encampment for a Book of Specialisation and two Weapon Set passive skill points.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_lost_lute", "locator": "Quest infobox; '===Search for Una's Lute===' and '===Return the Lute to Una===' quest log; '===Quest Complete===' (Book of Specialisation, two Weapon Set Passive Skill Points)"}]

name: The Search (PoE2 Act 4)
summary: PoE2 Act 4 main quest: the Exile, Doryani, Alva and the Hooded One reach Kingsmarch, hire a boat (Makoru of the Aurora May, under the Meridian Free Traders) and seek the three pieces of the Precursor weapon, ending with Tavakai.

name: The Slithering Dead (PoE2 quest)
summary: Optional Act 3 quest: Servi asks the Exile to find the source of the Azakh-Kul poison; in the Venom Crypts' Den of the Serpent Priestess the Exile finds Corpse-snake Venom, which Servi turns into a Venom Draught, giving a permanent choice of Stun Threshold, Elemental Ailment Threshold or Mana Regeneration.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_slithering_dead", "locator": "Infobox (act 3, start 'Entering the Venom Crypts'); quest logs '===Take the Corpse-snake Venom===' and '===Take a Venom Draught===' ; Rewards section"}]

name: The Trail of Corruption (Act 2 quest)
summary: Act 2 main quest: the Hooded One and Sekhema Asala pursue the Beast's trail of Corruption across the Vastiri desert from the Ardura Caravan, through Mawdun Mine, Traitor's Passage and the Halani Gates, the Horn of the Vastiri and Deshar, to the Dreadnought where Jamanra, the Abomination is defeated. Distinct from the Act 1 quest event_trail_of_corruption_act1.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_trail_of_corruption_act_2", "locator": "Infobox (act 2, start 'Enter the Ardura Caravan'); Rewards section; quest log headings '===Speak to the Hooded One===' through '===Quest Complete===' (pursuit of Jamanra, the Abomination)"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_quest", "locator": "Act 2 list: 'The Trail of Corruption (Act 2)' with sub-quests 'A Theft of Ivory', 'The City of Seven Waters' and 'A Crown of Stone' nested under it"}]

name: Treacherous Ground (PoE2 quest)
summary: Optional Act 1 quest: Renly asks the Exile to find and kill the Devourer in its Mud Burrow beneath Clearfell so the Ezomytes can leave the walls; the reward is a level 1 Uncut Support Gem and 100 gold.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_treacherous_ground", "locator": "Quest infobox ('required: No', act 1, start 'Talk to Renly'); '===Slay the Devourer===' walkthrough; '===Talk to Renly for your reward===' and '===Quest Complete==='"}]

name: Treasures of Utzaal (PoE2 quest)
summary: Optional Act 3 quest begun by Oswald: monkey statues lead to The Molten Vault, where the Exile defeats Mektul, the Forgemaster, who drops The Hammer of Kamasa; returning the hammer to Oswald unlocks the Reforging Bench.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_treasures_of_utzaal", "locator": "Infobox (act 3, start 'Summon Oswald in front of the Molten Vault', completion 'Bring The Hammer of Kamasa to Oswald'); '===Speak to Oswald===' quote on the Monkey God (Kamasa); '===Defeat Mektul, the Forgemaster===' and '===Quest Complete==='"}]

name: Trial of the Ancestors (PoE2 quest)
summary: Optional PoE2 Act 4 quest unlocked by freeing Matiki; the Exile meets Hinekora in the Trial of the Ancestors and receives the Tattoo of Hinekora.

name: Tribal Medicine (PoE2 quest)
summary: Optional Act 4 quest from Kaimana in Ngakanu: the Exile fetches a Shark Fin from the Great White One on Whakapanu Island so Kaimana can make an elixir against the Blood Fever. The reward is a permanent choice of Kaom's Lesson or Rakiata's Lesson.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_tribal_medicine", "locator": "Infobox (act 4, optional, start 'Picking up Shark Fin', completion 'Deliver the Shark Fin to Kaimana'); lead; Rewards (Kaom's Lesson / Rakiata's Lesson, 'cannot be changed'); quest logs '===Speak to Kaimana===' "}]

name: Tribal Vengeance (PoE2 quest)
summary: Optional Act 3 quest in The Azak Bog: Servi asks the Exile to slay Ignagduk, the Bog Witch, at Gor-gor Mog to free the stolen children of her tribe, then to return her Ghastly Spear to Servi for a magic charm.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_tribal_vengeance", "locator": "Infobox (act 3, boss Ignagduk, the Bog Witch); quest logs '===Talk to Servi===' and '===Kill Ignagduk==='; Rewards section (charms)"}]

name: Vaal Incursion (PoE2 quest, removed)
summary: Former Epilogue quest started by investigating The Burning Monolith; the boss is Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge. The wiki marks it as historical content, removed from the game.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_vaal_incursion", "locator": "Infobox (act 'Epilogue', start 'Investigate The Burning Monolith', boss Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge); '{{Historical content}}' and 'Removed from the game'"}]

name: Testing the Waygate
summary: Doryani has the Exile run the first Waystone map; he had not tested the Waygate beforehand ('Science is a process').
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_precursors", "locator": "quest steps 'Select and enter a Map' / Doryani 'Our first step is a success! The Waygate does indeed work.'"}]

name: The Exile discovers the Well of Souls
summary: In Act 2 the Exile follows Abyssal fissures into the Lightless Passage; the Hooded One teaches them the Abyssal tongue and names Kulemak.

name: Whakapanu Island (PoE2 quest)
summary: Required Act 4 side quest, begun by speaking to Makoru and sailing to Whakapanu Island; the Exile enters the Singing Caverns and kills the Siren Diamora. Part of the rotating Act 4 requirements.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_whakapanu_island_quest", "locator": "Infobox (required: Yes, act 4, start 'Sailing to Whakapanu Island', completion 'Defeat Diamora, Song of Death'); quest log '===Enter the Singing Caverns===' to '===Kill Diamora==='"}]

name: Precursor Cataclysm
summary: After mastering corruption the Precursors delved into world secrets, triggering great fires, eruptions and impacts from the sky; the civilisation was wiped out by an unknown cataclysm. Cause unclear.

name: Priesthood conspiracy (stabbing of Olroth)
summary: High Priest Uhtred, suspecting Olroth of fighting for the horrors in his sleep, had a dozen priests stab him (71 wounds); Vorana killed all twelve; Olroth was encased in glass and Uhtred fled to an ancient site of power.

name: Purity Rebellion
summary: A rebellion led by High Templar Voll and the poet Victario, with King Kaom, Sekhema Deshret and Thane Rigwald. It culminates in the siege of Sarn (Divini, 1334 IC) and Voll's coronation.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "sections 'The Purity Rebellion', 'Siege of Sarn', 'Assassination of Chitus'"}, {"source_id": "src_book_path_of_exile_origins", "locator": "issues #1-4 (Death to Sin / The Black Heart)"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_voll_emperor_of_purity", "locator": "Lore"}]

name: The Temple Door Idol from the Queen of Filth
summary: The Exile enters the Drowned City and Aggorat, defeats the Queen of Filth, and takes the Temple Door Idol to open the Temple of Kopec.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "Quest 'Defeat the Queen of Filth' / 'Pick up the Temple Door Idol'"}]

name: Rapture Device activation
summary: 1336 IC; Dialla refuses; Malachai enters Beast.

name: Slay the Bloated Miller
summary: The Exile follows a wounded man's warning to Clearfell, kills the Bloated Miller, and receives a reward from Renly (the quest is on The Riverbank; the Miller attacks the camp).

name: The Red Communion
summary: Project that allowed Atziri to commune directly with the Beast. Doryani, privately opposed, was forced to devise it; he learned all he could and prepared contingencies. It triggered the Vaal Cataclysm.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_vaal", "locator": "section 'The Vaal Cataclysm' (PoE2 account)"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_environmental_lore", "locator": "Spymaster note: 'consequences of the Red Communion'"}]

name: Return of the Sun
summary: The Winter of the World ends: Maraketh tradition credits twin sekhema Solerai and Lundara expelling the Lightless; official Abyss text credits Solaris. Sources differ (possibly the same figures).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "The Lightless final paragraph; The Maraketh"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_maraketh", "locator": "Solerai and Lundara"}]

name: Dispel the sandstorm with the Horn of the Vastiri
summary: The Exile sounds the Horn of the Vastiri at the sandstorm, dispelling Jamanra's barrier, and Asala then turns the caravan toward Deshar.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_trail_of_corruption_act_2", "locator": "Quest 'Use the Horn of the Vastiri' / 'Speak to Asala'"}]

name: The Searing Exarch (quest)
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "PoE1 endgame (3.17.0 Siege of the Atlas)", "story_order": 3082, "parallel_group": "atlas_pinnacle_quests"}
summary: Epilogue quest added in 3.17.0 and run in parallel with The Maven and The Eater of Worlds quests. The Envoy gives the Luminous Astrolabe, which lets the Exile add Searing Exarch influence to Tier 9 to 16 maps. The Tier 11 map boss drops a Polaric Invitation to the Black Star's arena (area level 79); the Tier 16 map boss drops an Incandescent Invitation to the Searing Exarch's arena (The Absence of Patience and Wisdom). The Black Star is defeated first, then the Searing Exarch. The quest pays out Atlas passive points (2 skill points, 4 respec points on completion) and an Omniscient Voidstone via Kirac; the Exarch drops an Eldritch Voidstone if The Eater of Worlds was defeated first.
curation: ["codex: Exarch climax missing from spine (parallel with Eater/Maven quests)", "codex audit round 2: parallel optional pinnacle quests"]
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_searing_exarch_quest", "locator": "infobox (boss The Searing Exarch) and Walkthrough: quest intro 'This quest runs in parallel to The Maven (quest) and The Eater of Worlds (quest)'; 'Use the Luminous Astrolabe', 'Polaric Invitation', 'Incandescent Invitation' steps; Quest Complete log 'You have gained 2 Atlas Passive Skill Points and 4 Atlas Passive Respec Points'; version history 3.17.0"}]

name: Release the Hooded One from the Tree of Souls
summary: In the Grelwood the Exile finds the Tree of Souls holding the Hooded One; Una says only runes can break the binding, so the Exile collects Runes of Power from the Red Vale and stabs them into the Tree with the forged Rune Spikes.

name: Seed of Corruption Released
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "about 20 years after Kitava's defeat", "story_order": null}
summary: About 20 years after Kitava's defeat, Count Geonor pierces the Hooded One with a runic sword and extracts the Seed of Corruption, which begins feeding on a soldier. Corruption spreads across Wraeclast and the Atlas.

name: Siege of Sarn
summary: On the last day of Divini 1334 IC, High Templar Voll laid siege to Sarn with Ezomyte, Karui and Maraketh rebel support. Cadiro Perandus negotiated Sarn's surrender on 1 Sacrato of Phreci 1334 IC, and Voll was crowned a week later.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "'Siege of Sarn'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "section 'Siege of Sarn (Divini, 1334 IC)' and the paragraph after 'Assassination of Chitus' (surrender and coronation)"}]

name: Sin Consults Kalandra
summary: Sin seeks Kalandra at her lake and receives cryptic instructions leading him to a Precursor ruin holding the Seed of Corruption, used to create the Beast. Etching V's 'little thief' is read as Sin; PoE1 link is inference, PoE2 wiki states it directly.

name: Slumber of the Gods
summary: Sin plants the Dark Ember in Highgate, creating the Beast, the source of thaumaturgy. The Beast initiates the Slumber of the Gods, which puts all gods to sleep.

name: Slumbering of the Gods
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "unknown, millennia before PoE1 (before the Vaal Empire per PoE2 wiki)", "story_order": null}
summary: Sin's Beast lulled the gods into dreamless slumber, ending an era of divine strife; Hinekora foresaw it and prepared the Halls of the Dead before sleeping.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_ingame_sin_dialogue", "locator": "Sin 'The Rise of the Gods': \"We gods, we were driven into slumbering darkness, to dream away eternity whilst the gentle Beast watched over us.\""}, {"source_id": "src_ingame_hinekora_dialogue", "locator": "Hinekora dream: 'She foresaw the Slumbering of the Gods' / hinekora wiki Lore"}]

name: Open the Memorial Gate for Lachlann
summary: In the Cemetery of the Eternals the Exile destroys Asinia and Praetor Draven for the two Memorial Key pieces, opens the gate, and puts Lachlann to rest.

name: Memory of the Templar Laboratory
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "Past of the Templar Laboratory, shortly before Valdo's imprisonment", "story_order": null}
summary: Tier-5+ Synthesis memory in which Cavas sees High Templar Venarius and the scientist Valdo Caeserius building something together; Venarius lashes out, triggering the realisation of Cavas's identity.

name: Templars shift to Oriath
summary: After the Cataclysm.

name: Templar Theocracy of Oriath
summary: After the Cataclysm, the Templars shift their base to Oriath and develop a theocracy. The Templar Courts and Chamber of Innocence are built under High Templar Avarius shortly before PoE1.

name: Defeat Ketzuli in the Temple of Kopec
summary: In the Temple of Kopec the Exile defeats Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun, and Alva activates an elevator and gateway into the Ziggurat's past.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "Quest 'Defeat Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun' / 'Ride the Elevator'"}]

name: The Maven's Game (quest)
summary: Epilogue quest that starts when the Exile enters Absence of Mercy and Empathy with a Maven's Writ; it culminates in the Maven pinnacle boss fight. Defeating the Maven unlocks the Ceremonial Voidstone (reported to Commander Kirac); the quest's final steps have the Exile use an Atlas Book of Skill for 1 Atlas passive skill point and 2 Atlas passive respec points.
curation: ["codex: Maven confrontation missing from Atlas spine", "codex audit round 2: parallel optional pinnacle quests"]
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_maven_s_game", "locator": "infobox (required=no, start 'Obtain a The Maven's Writ', completion 'Defeat The Maven') and Walkthrough: quest-log lines 'Challenge the Maven', 'Talk to Commander Kirac', 'Use the Atlas Book of Skill'; version history 3.13.0 'Introduced to the game'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_maven_quest", "locator": "Walkthrough, final paragraph: after the final invitation the player forms 'The Maven's Writ which is used to challenge The Maven'"}]

name: Revive the Hooded One with Count Lachlann's ring
summary: Through the Grim Tangle, the Exile brings Count Lachlann's ring to Una, who revives the Hooded One; he reveals the Seed of Corruption is in Ogham and must be recovered.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_mysterious_shade", "locator": "Quest 'Witness the revival of the Hooded One'"}]

name: The Rogue Harbour (quest)
summary: Act 6 introductory quest for the Heist mechanic: after Kurai and a Rogue's Marker, the Exile opens a portal to The Rogue Harbour, takes Contract: Trial Run from Kurai and finishes it with Karst.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_rogue_harbour_quest", "locator": "Quest infobox: act 6, required no, start 'Lioneye's Watch (Act 6)', completion 'Talk to Kurai after finishing the contract'; Version history 3.12.0 'Introduced to the game'"}]

name: Mastodon Tusks from the Bone Pits
summary: In the Bone Pits the Exile defeats Ekbab and Iktab for the Mastodon Tusks that Jamanra wanted for lightning powers.
curation: ["codex audit round 2: relic errands in any order"]

name: Threads of the Originator
summary: Epilogue quest starting the Secrets of the Atlas storyline; the Exile follows Memory Threads with Eagon to find the Originator.

name: Enter the time gateway to Utzaal's past
summary: The gateway sends the Exile and Alva into Utzaal's past, where the Vaal see Alva and the Exile as threats while the Cataclysm is imminent.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "Quest 'Enter the Time Portal' / 'Enter Utzaal in the past'"}]

name: Titans and Humans Fight the Rising Darkness
summary: A 'rising darkness' (likely the Lightless after the Winter of the World) attacks Titans and humans; surviving Titans forge weapons and unearth the first virtue gem, but are almost wiped out.

name: Defeat Tor Gul in the Spires of Deshar
summary: In Deshar the Exile climbs the Path of Mourning to the Spires, where the Faridun have taken the honoured dead, and defeats Tor Gul, the Defiler.

name: Toward the Future
summary: Act 10 quest closing the campaign: after defeating Kitava, Lilly Roth in Oriath Docks offers to sail the Exile away; completing it is 'Set Sail from Oriath'.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_toward_the_future", "locator": "Quest infobox: act 10, start 'Talk to Lilly Roth in Oriath Docks', completion 'Set Sail from Oriath'; Walkthrough: 'Talk to Lilly Roth after defeating Kitava'"}]

name: Kill the Executioner and free Leitis
summary: The Exile finds the Executioner at Ogham Village, frees his prisoner Leitis, and Leitis (who says 'He killed Eamon') then asks the Exile to depose Count Geonor.

name: Merchant Wars and War of the Great Families
summary: Feud between House Keita and House Bardiya that escalated into civil war and ended in a ceasefire and the Merchant Council.

name: Trarthan Rebellion against Phrecius (870 IC)
summary: Warlords of Trarthus were executed after Phrecian legions occupied it; four first-generation Trarthans led a war; Karui blockades and Ezomyte sabotage doomed reinforcements; Tyndarus capitulated after two years.

name: Trarthan War of Independence
summary: 870-872 IC rebellion against Tyndarus.

name: Trial of the Ancestors
summary: Tournament in the Halls of the Dead where the Exile's team of Karui warriors fights teams led by the ten Karui chieftains, destroying totems; winning a full tournament earns rewards from Hinekora (omens, Hinekora's Lock, unique items).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_ancestor_league", "locator": "'==League mechanic=='"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_hinekora", "locator": "'rules over the Halls of the Dead and oversees the Trial of the Ancestors'"}]

name: Trials of Chaos
summary: Escalating wave trials in which a Trialmaster-set modifier is added each round; the player banks or risks rewards. PoE1 Ultimatum league (3.14), core in 3.23; PoE2 Ascension Trial of Chaos (Act 3 Temple of Chaos, up to 10 trials).

name: Destruction of the Triskelion Flame
summary: In defeating Olroth the exile cannot save the Flame, which was keeping him alive; Dannig asks the exile to keep this from the settlers.

name: Loss of the Triskelion Flame
summary: The starlight barrier vanished as Vorana tried to adjust it; the Flame's altar was empty and all harbour ships but one had been burned. Vorana branded Uhtred a traitor, and Olroth's glass case was found empty. Uhtred had fled to an ancient shrine.

name: Turning the Tide
summary: Endgame Curse of the Allflame quest required to unlock Velka, the Tide Witch: Vesper imbues the Exile with the Allflame to pass Velka's barrier, then the Exile defeats Velka and retrieves her Allflame.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_turning_the_tide", "locator": "Quest infobox: start 'Explore a Kishara's Rest chart', objective 'Defeat Velka and retrieve her Allflame', act 'Epilogue'; Walkthrough: 'Allow me to imbue you with the power of the Allflame'"}]

name: Twilight Order rebuilds Oriath
summary: After the abandonment, the Twilight Order emerged from secrecy and rebuilt Oriath in secret; Act 5 is set there and the Beast is held there (per Kanu).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_twilight_order", "locator": "intro"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_act_5", "locator": "intro: 'Oriath, which was rebuilt in secret'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Kanu: 'they're in Oriath'"}]

name: Survive the Utzaal Cataclysm through the gateway
summary: The Exile and Alva survive the Cataclysm in Utzaal's past and return through the gateway with Doryani, who then laments that his people are long dead.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "Quest 'Use the Gateway' / 'Survive the Cataclysm'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "Survive the Cataclysm"}]

name: Vaal first contact with the Azmeri
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "c. 1160 BC (~2,500 years before Chitus, per Trinian)", "story_order": null}
summary: Around 1160 BC (Trinian, writing c. 1333 IC, says about 2,500 years earlier) the Vaal first contacted the primitive Azmeri tribes of the Azmerian ranges, introducing agriculture and literacy and helping create the first Azmerian written language, while never divulging the secret of virtue gems.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_vaal", "locator": "section 'Contacting the Azmeri'; Trinian, The Ancients Book 4"}]

name: Vaal Cataclysm
summary: Event c. 400 BIC that ended the Vaal Empire: Doryani's project to grant immortality (manipulating the Beast, corruption, gems, sacrifice and 'communion') went wrong; only 3,126 Vaal survived and took refuge with the Azmeri. PoE2 shows the Red Communion and Atziri being swallowed by the Beast.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "section 'The Vaal Cataclysm'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "section 'The Vaal Cataclysm' (paragraph on Path of Exile 2: Fate of the Vaal)"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_vaal", "locator": "section 'The Vaal Cataclysm'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_doryani", "locator": "section 'Vaal Cataclysm'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_atziri_the_red_queen", "locator": "Abilities: 'cutscene... swallowed by the Beast and starting the Cataclysm'"}]

name: Survivors among the Azmeri
summary: The 3,126 surviving Vaal found refuge among the Azmeri, could not explain what happened, had no gems and assimilated until none remained; they panicked at an image of a gem shown by the Kalguur.

name: Vastiri Becomes a Desert
summary: Over thousands of years the plains' rivers dried and forests became sand, naturally or via Maraketh/Halani-linked causes; the Maraketh became semi-nomadic.

name: Defeat Viper Napuatzi in Utzaal's past
summary: In Utzaal's past the Vaal general Viper Napuatzi has Alva taken to Doryani; the Exile defeats Napuatzi to open the path.

name: Ban on collecting virtue gems in Kalguur
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "during the reign of Cadigan III (ancient Kalguur)", "story_order": null}
summary: After the Azmeri reacted fearfully to virtue gems, King Cadigan the Third officially banned their collection; the gems never returned to Kalguur (Kalguur page, Thaumaturgy section).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "===Thaumaturgy===: \"after witnessing the Azmeris' fearful reaction towards virtue gems, King Cadigan the Third had officially banned their collection\""}]

name: Voll crowned Emperor
summary: Voll of Thebrus crowned Emperor in Sacrato of Phreci 1334 IC (Eternal Empire page: a week after Cadiro's surrender on 1 Sacrato of Phreci; Purity Chronicles Book 1 says the 2nd Sacrato of Phreci).

name: Voll's pact with Deshret
summary: Voll promises Sekhema Deshret the return of the Vastiri Plains for Maraketh support; she demands Titucius' skin for a saddle.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "'Defeat of Titucius'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_purity_chronicles", "locator": "Book 4: The Red Sekhema's Saddle"}]

name: Voll's pact with Kaom
summary: Voll and Victario visit Kaom in Ngamakanui; Voll promises Karui sovereignty over Wraeclast's south shore and freedom for slaves in exchange for attacking Lioneye's Watch.

name: Winter of the World
aliases: ["Winter of the World (Great Fire / Great Wasting)"]
summary: Ancient war in which Kulemak and the Lightless blanketed the Vastiri Plains and the surface, ended when the Three Sisters (Solerai/Lundara etc.) destroyed Kulemak's mortal form and brought back the sun.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "intro paragraph 2"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_three_sisters", "locator": "paragraph 2"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_kulemak", "locator": "paragraph 1: 'Winter of the World ... lasted for centuries'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_lightless", "locator": "Winter of the World"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_three_sisters", "locator": "lead"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_ezomytes", "locator": "The Great Fire"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "Great Fire: 'revealed that the Great Fire was indeed the same event as the Winter of the World'"}]

name: Defeat Xyclucian and enter the Machinarium
summary: In the Chimeral Wetlands the Exile defeats Xyclucian, the Chimera, and enters Jiquani's Machinarium, where Alva sends them after a small Soul Core.

name: Zana the Originator Fractures the Atlas
summary: After the Incarnation of Dread, Zana tells Eagon she must destroy the Atlas, 'I am the catalyst', fracturing it into four quadrants and burning its pages; 3.28.0 rendering visible as the destroyed Atlas.

name: Doryani's investigation of Zerphi
summary: Atziri ordered Doryani to research Zerphi's rejuvenation 'within the realms of possibility... without fear of question or consequence'; Vaal aged 16-26 were sent to him and none survived, the experiments failing.

name: Defeat Zicoatl and take the large Soul Core
summary: Inside Jiquani's Sanctum the Exile powers two generators with medium Soul Cores and defeats Zicoatl, Warden of the Core, to take the large Soul Core.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "Quest 'Activate two Generators' / 'Defeat Zicoatl, Warden of the Core'"}]

name: Arrive at the Ziggurat Encampment in Utzaal
summary: The Hooded One sends the Exile to Utzaal; the Exile crosses the Sandswept Marsh to the Ziggurat, meeting Oswald and Alva.

name: The Afarud
summary: Rogue Faridun sect that torments djinn; led by figures such as Ridan, Afarud Commander.

name: Ardura Akhara
summary: Maraketh akhara (caravan order) led by Sekhema Asala and Zarka that the Exile joins in Act 2.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_earning_passage", "locator": "Walkthrough 'Enter the Ardura Caravan'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_trail_of_corruption_act_2", "locator": "Quest log 'Speak to the Sekhema'"}]

name: Azmeri
summary: Ancient tribal people of the Azmerian ranges who worship Solaris, Lunaris, Viridi and others. Eighty thousand of them under Tarcus Veruso descended into the former Vaal lands and founded the Eternal Empire in 1 IC; the Azmeri of the Forest Encampment and the Wildwood descend from those who stayed behind.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_azmeri", "locator": "intro"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "The Azmeri"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_azmeri", "locator": "lead paragraph, 'Notable members'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "section 'The Azmeri' / 'Imperialis Conceptus (1 IC)'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_intruders_in_black", "locator": "Helena dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_vaal", "locator": "Contacting the Azmeri"}]

name: Bandit Lords
summary: Three rival exile bandit leaders extorting the Forest Encampment.

name: Black Scythe
summary: Kalguuran mercenaries (mostly crossbow arbalists) led by Vorana, responsible for the expedition's defence and offence. Their artifacts are the currency of the Expedition NPC Tujen.

name: Black Scythes
summary: Kalguuran mercenaries led by Vorana, fighting horrors from walls with crossbows.

name: Brinerot
summary: Pirate/whaler warband of the sea whose corsairs ambush chart-seekers; their Shamanessa Velka traffics with the dead.

name: Brotherhood of Silence
summary: Assassins-for-hire based primarily in Sarn, also called the Silent Brotherhood. The wiki says it acted as a hit squad for many of the Eternal Empire's elite (business with Cadiro and the Perandus family), framed Jorgin for his brother's death so he was exiled from Ogham, and surrounded Drusus in the Bath House until he drowned himself. Listed members: Shadow (former), Coralito and Vorici.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_brotherhood_of_silence", "locator": "lead paragraph: 'faction of assassins-for-hire based primarily in Sarn'; section 'Lore': 'acted as a hit squad for many of the elite of the Eternal Empire' and the Jorgin and Drusus incidents. Era is not dated on the page (confidence low)."}]

name: The Caaltu
summary: A civilisation that existed in Kahuturoa's time (Vastiri still forest, Vaal extant, Oriath recently founded, Ezomyr not yet struck by plague) and was only a memory by Maata's time. Little else is known.

name: Citizen Vanguard
summary: Force Kirac leads to defend Wraeclast against coming darkness; over 800 died against Sirus in Siege timeline.

name: The Cuachic
summary: Isolated Vaal remnant in Mount Kriar's vault, living under strict control for generations; recruited by Doryani's phrase in PoE2 Interlude.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_vaal", "locator": "Quest complete: Hooded One warning"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_vaal", "locator": "quest log"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_environmental_lore", "locator": "Cuachic Legacy"}]

name: Cultists of Kitava
summary: Followers of Kitava who plunder refugee ships fleeing Oriath, flood Oriath after its fall (Vilenta lets them into the Overseer's Tower) and hunt for food for their god; the drowned they leave behind wash ashore at the Twilight Strand.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_fallen_from_grace", "locator": "Lilly: cultists have been plundering the refugee ships"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_death_and_rebirth", "locator": "Bannon: Kitava's cultists are constantly on the prowl seeking food for their god"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_safe_passage", "locator": "Lani: Vilenta led the cultists into the Overseer's Tower"}]

name: Druids of Skothe
summary: Ancient order that venerated the Azmeri Draiocht and practised the mystic arts of the Maji; the Druid (an Ezomyte) was once a member. Wiped out by the King in the Mists and his cultists, who deceived them by disguising himself as a Maji of the old.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_druid", "locator": "page 'Lore': 'The Druid is an Ezomyte who was once part of the Druids of Skothe, an ancient order that venerated the Azmeri Draíocht and practiced the mystic arts of the Maji.'"}]

name: Druids of the Broken Circle
summary: Kalguuran nature-mystics under Medved, named after Olroth's gem use clouded their scrying.

name: Ebony Legion / Blackguards
summary: Dominus's Templar soldiers: Ebony Legion and Blackguards who enforce Oriath's rule and hunt in Wraeclast.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_dominus", "locator": "Lore: He also controls the Ebony Legion"}]

name: The Elderslayers
summary: Group Zana assembled to hunt the Elder: Baran, Veritania, Drox, Al-Hezmin, led by Sirus. They became the Conquerors of the Atlas after going mad.

name: Eternal Empire
chronology: {"in_world_year": 1, "relative": "1 IC to c. 1339 IC; roughly 260 years before PoE1 (1599-1600 IC)", "story_order": null}
summary: Oriathan/imperial civilisation, also called the Sarn Empire, founded in 1 IC by Azmeri migrants under Tarcus Veruso on the ruins of the Vaal capital. Ruled by Emperors from Sarn, it held most of central Wraeclast with a Roman-style legion system until the Cataclysm (c. 1339 IC) destroyed it; Oriath survived as its successor.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "lead paragraph and sections 'History' through 'The Cataclysm'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_act_1", "locator": "Act 1: Cemetery of the Eternals / Eternal prison areas"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "section 'The Eternal Empire'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "lead"}]

name: Exiles of Wraeclast
summary: Convicted Oriathans banished to Wraeclast; survive at Lioneye's Watch and later camps.

name: Ezomytes
summary: Clan people of Ezomyr, subjugated and enslaved by the Eternal Empire. Thane Rigwald rallied them in the Bloody Flowers Rebellion of 1333 IC and they joined the siege of Sarn.

name: Faridun
summary: Maraketh rejects (flawed or mutated newborns left in the dunes) raised by wandering Faridun tribes in the Vastiri, who accept necromancy and long for reunification with the akharas. In PoE2 Act 2 the Countess recruits them with the promise of resurrecting Jamanra.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_faridun", "locator": "'Overview' and 'Events in Path of Exile 2'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_maraketh", "locator": "'Lore: The Faridun'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_faridun", "locator": "intro"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "section 'The Faridun'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_faridun", "locator": "Overview and Events in Path of Exile 2"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_maraketh", "locator": "Jado dialogue"}]

name: Gemling Legion
summary: Elite legions of the Eternal Empire created by Malachai: legionnaires infused with virtue gems, led by Captains, which gave the Empire military dominance. Chitus carried a master gem whose heartbeat bound every gemling to his own, so they fell when he died; survivors were transformed by the Cataclysm into the Undying.

name: The Godless Three
summary: Three thaumaturgists trained by Malachai: Shavronne of Umbra, Maligaro the Inquisitor and Doedre Darktongue. Maligaro and Doedre were burned by Voll; Malachai later revived all three to guard his heart, lungs and entrails.

name: House Azadi
summary: Trarthan Great House. Contract-assassin monopoly.

name: House Bardiya
summary: Trarthan Great House. Financiers; Merchant Council with greatest control today.

name: House Cyaxan
summary: Trarthan Great House. Drug trade, criminal syndicate and mass virtue gem implantation.

name: House Keita
summary: Trarthan Great House. Slave armies, flesh pits; failed to become a god; founded Korathin 872 IC.

name: The Immortal Syndicate
summary: Group of resurrected criminals and the missing forsaken masters under Catarina (the Mastermind), with 17 other members in four divisions (Transportation, Fortification, Research, Intervention); aims to become the ruling power in Wraeclast. Jun believes (not confirmed) the Horns of Kulamac give them their return-from-death ability.

name: Kalguuran settlers
summary: Runesmith people of Middengard who built Kingsmarch (Rog, Tujen, Dannig, Gwennen), led by the Cadigan kings; PoE1 Settlers of Kalguur continues into PoE2 Act 4.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "'==Culture==' Runes/Faith/Thaumaturgy/Monarchy"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "intro, Notable members"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_environmental_lore", "locator": "Cadigan the Wise"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_vaal", "locator": "The Vaal Cataclysm"}]

name: Karui
summary: Seafaring warrior people of the southern archipelago. Under King Kaom they allied with Voll's Purity Rebellion, took Lioneye's Watch and founded the first Karui settlement on the mainland; Kaom later fell at Highgate. The Empire had enslaved Karui under Chitus.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "The Karui"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_king_kaom", "locator": "'The Purity Rebellion and the Cataclysm'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "'Slave trade'; 'Lioneye's Watch'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_karui", "locator": "lead"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_karui", "locator": "intro + chieftains"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_environmental_lore", "locator": "Words of Akoya"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "Doryani"}]

summary: Karui tribe that honours the Karui Ancestor Arohongui and is led by the chieftain Ikiaho; each tribe offers a unique item in the Trial of the Ancestors.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_karui", "locator": "tribe/chieftain list; 'The Karui tribes are grouped by the Karui Ancestor they currently worship'"}]

name: Hinekora tribe
summary: Karui tribe that honours the Karui Ancestor Hinekora and is led by the chieftain Tawhanuku; each tribe offers a unique item in the Trial of the Ancestors.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_karui", "locator": "tribe/chieftain list; 'The Karui tribes are grouped by the Karui Ancestor they currently worship'"}]

summary: Karui tribe that honours the Karui Ancestor Kitava and is led by the chieftain Utula; each tribe offers a unique item in the Trial of the Ancestors.

summary: Karui tribe that honours the Karui Ancestor Ngamahu and is led by the chieftain Kaom; each tribe offers a unique item in the Trial of the Ancestors.

summary: Karui tribe that honours the Karui Ancestor Ramako and is led by the chieftain Ahuana; each tribe offers a unique item in the Trial of the Ancestors.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_karui", "locator": "tribe/chieftain list; 'The Karui tribes are grouped by the Karui Ancestor they currently worship'"}]

name: Rongokurai tribe
summary: Karui tribe that honours the Karui Ancestor Rongokurai and is led by the chieftain Kahuturoa; each tribe offers a unique item in the Trial of the Ancestors.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_karui", "locator": "tribe/chieftain list; 'The Karui tribes are grouped by the Karui Ancestor they currently worship'"}]

summary: Karui tribe that honours the Karui Ancestor Tasalio and is led by the chieftain Rakiata; each tribe offers a unique item in the Trial of the Ancestors.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_karui", "locator": "tribe/chieftain list; 'The Karui tribes are grouped by the Karui Ancestor they currently worship'"}]

name: Tawhoa tribe
summary: Karui tribe that honours the Karui Ancestor Tawhoa and is led by the chieftain Maata; each tribe offers a unique item in the Trial of the Ancestors.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_karui", "locator": "tribe/chieftain list; 'The Karui tribes are grouped by the Karui Ancestor they currently worship'"}]

name: Tukohama tribe
summary: Karui tribe that honours the Karui Ancestor Tukohama and is led by the chieftain Akoya; each tribe offers a unique item in the Trial of the Ancestors.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_karui", "locator": "tribe/chieftain list; 'The Karui tribes are grouped by the Karui Ancestor they currently worship'"}]

name: Valako tribe
summary: Karui tribe that honours the Karui Ancestor Valako and is led by the chieftain Kiloava; each tribe offers a unique item in the Trial of the Ancestors.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_karui", "locator": "tribe/chieftain list; 'The Karui tribes are grouped by the Karui Ancestor they currently worship'"}]

name: Keepers of the Flame (Order of the Purple Flame)
summary: Monastic order founded by Ailith after her visions of the Dreamer; they train in the Monastery to defend Wraeclast against the Hiveborn and tend the Genesis Tree. The PoE2 wiki calls it the Order of the Purple Flame; the Monk class belongs to it. It is a taboo among them to speak the Dreamer's true name (Chayula).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_dreamer", "locator": "Lore"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_into_the_breach", "locator": "Visit the Monastery of the Keepers: \"Welcome to our Monastery...\""}]

name: Knights of the Sun
summary: Warriors and military enforcers under direct orders of the King, led by Olroth.

name: The Lightless
summary: Necromantic army of possessed golems created by Kulemak, led by Abyssal Liches; ended the primeval civilisation.

name: The Maji
summary: Azmeri vanguard chosen when the Wildwood was made; they purge the Nameless and fight the King in the Mists, forbidden from touching virtue gems ('Tears of the Maji').

name: Maraketh
summary: Desert people of the Vastiri led by Sekhemas, living in akhara (tribes). In 1333 IC Sekhema Deshret joined the Purity Rebellion in exchange for the return of the Vastiri Plains; later, Deshret sealed the Highgate mines. A large tribe lives at Highgate in PoE1; the Ardura akhara and Sekhema Asala appear in PoE2.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "The Maraketh"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_maraketh", "locator": "intro"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_maraketh", "locator": "'Notable members' and 'History'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "section 'Defeat of Titucius'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_faridun", "locator": "'Events in Path of Exile 2'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_breaking_the_seal", "locator": "Oyun dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_faridun", "locator": "Overview"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_trail_of_corruption_act_2", "locator": "Quest log"}]

name: Meridian Free Traders
summary: Trade guild that sent Raulf to assist executing the Kingsmarch charter; in PoE2 it controls boat charters (Makoru captains the Aurora May under it).

name: Mutewind (warband)
summary: One of the three Warbands in Warbands league, alongside Brinerot and Redblades; the wiki calls them the Peak-dwellers. Their outcast Qianga delivered the Starforge to the Watchers of Decay for the Order of the Djinn. Mutewind Warbands also appear as bosses in the Delve map Frozen Hollow.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_list_of_warbands_and_tempest_league_challenges", "locator": "Warbands item list: Mutewind Wildrunner, Mutewind Lynx, Mutewind Seal"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_order_of_the_djinn", "locator": "Qianga entry: 'a Mutewind warband outcast'; 'The Mutewind|Peak-dwellers'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_frozen_hollow", "locator": "Contains Mutewind Warbands as bosses"}]

name: House Grattus (Necropolis dead)
summary: One of five Eternal Empire-era families whose haunted dead (four members each) can be buried in the Necropolis to grave-craft the unique 'Grattus Signet'.

name: House Nevalius (Necropolis dead)
summary: One of five Eternal Empire-era families whose haunted dead (four members each) can be buried in the Necropolis to grave-craft the unique 'Nevalius Inheritance'.

name: House Perandus (Necropolis dead)
summary: One of five Eternal Empire-era families whose haunted dead (four members each) can be buried in the Necropolis to grave-craft the unique 'The Perandus Pact'.

name: House Phrecia (Necropolis dead)
summary: One of five Eternal Empire-era families whose haunted dead (four members each) can be buried in the Necropolis to grave-craft the unique 'The Hand of Phrecia'.

name: House Veruso (Necropolis dead)
summary: One of five Eternal Empire-era families whose haunted dead (four members each) can be buried in the Necropolis to grave-craft the unique 'Veruso's Ambition'.

name: Order of the Chalice
summary: Kalguuran priesthood (Priests of the Chalice) that interpreted the stars and mastered alchemy, machinery and runes; Uhtred was its High Priest.

name: Order of the Djinn
summary: Secret society founded in ancient times by the Maraketh and the Clayshaper (Ahkeli) that protects Wraeclast from calamity and guards dangerous artefacts (Forbidden Vaults near the Oasis, Act 9); takes one orphan from each culture. Members forged and delivered the Starforge to the Watchers of Decay (video). Janus Perandus's betrayal let Catarina raid the vault and the Order was slain except Jun and Janus; in PoE2 Jun is rebuilding it. Past members include Ixchel (later the Trialmaster).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_order_of_the_djinn", "locator": "lead paragraph and 'Historical members'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_icius_perandus", "locator": "'Lore'"}, {"source_id": "src_yt_6tP4TcFw4Lo", "locator": "1:07 order of the Djinn; 16:34 Starforge; 20:10 infiltration of Forbidden Vault"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_order_of_the_djinn", "locator": "page"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_order_of_the_djinn", "locator": "Members / Jun rebuilding"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_order_of_the_djinn", "locator": "lead and Members"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_order_of_the_djinn", "locator": "intro"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_order_of_the_djinn", "locator": "lead; Members"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_order_of_the_djinn", "locator": "PoE2 page"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_maraketh", "locator": "Jado dialogue"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_order_of_the_djinn", "locator": "lead"}]

name: The Pale Council
summary: Group of four Pale Court bosses (Yriel, Eber, Volkuur and Inya) fought through the Prophecy system; the wiki says the Pale Council fight no longer exists after 3.17.0. In the wiki's in-world history the Pale Council were rulers of an unidentified people, likely the Karui.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "section 'The Pale Council': '[[The Pale Council]] is a group comprising of Yriel, the Feral Lord, Eber, the Plaguemaw, Volkuur, and Inya'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_inya_the_unbearable_whispers", "locator": "Drops: 'sequence of last alive member of the Pale Council is random'; Version history 3.0.0 'The Pale Council encounter has been rebalanced'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_volkuur_the_unbreathing_queen", "locator": "Header: 'The Pale Council fight no longer exists in Path of Exile'"}]

name: Perandus family
summary: Wealthiest merchant-lender family of the Eternal Empire (motto 'With piety and justice'). Blocked from the throne by the Phrecians, they rigged Izaro's Labyrinth so Chitus Perandus won; Cadiro looted the treasury before the fall. Descendants include Syndicate member Janus Perandus.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_perandus_family", "locator": "'History' and 'Members'"}, {"source_id": "src_ggg_perandus_challenge_leagues", "locator": "forum announcement describing Cadiro's stolen treasury and indebted dead"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_perandus_family", "locator": "page"}, {"source_id": "src_yt_6tP4TcFw4Lo", "locator": "13:54"}]

name: Phrecian dynasty
summary: Unbroken line of emperors descended from Alano Phrecia, who founded the line after killing the 'dark being' in 35 IC. It ran from Alano through Romira and Tyndarus to Izaro, who was childless.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_eternal_empire", "locator": "sections 'Reign of Alano Phrecia' to 'Reign of Izaro'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_ancients", "locator": "Book 7: The Light of Phrecia"}]

name: Precursors
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "further before the Vaal than the Vaal are before the present", "story_order": null}
summary: Technologically superior ancient civilisation that wholly predates the Winter of the World; mastered corruption, built the Towers (terraforming), the Precursor Weapon and the Arbiter of Ash, then triggered cataclysms of fire, eruptions and sky-impacts. Pictographs read 'Death lies within'.

name: Priests of the Chalice
summary: Religious order that read the stars and mastered alchemy, machinery and runes.

name: Primeval Civilization ("Proto-Vaal")
summary: Ancient civilisation preceding the Vaal, unearthed in the Azurite Mine; the name "Proto-Vaal" is an internal term never used in-game and no link to the Vaal is established.

name: Purity Rebellion
summary: Coalition led by High Templar Voll of Thebrus against Chitus' gem-and-thaumaturgy 'thaumatocracy'. Its supporters included Victario, Ondar, Geofri, Kastov and Adus, with Ezomyte, Karui and Maraketh allies.

name: Redblades
summary: Human tribe descended from those who settled the Titans' volcanoes; they ritually sacrifice humans to the Molten One, possibly because a Titan destroyed an outpost of El'Abin.

name: Remembrancers
summary: Kalguuran scribes who documented the explorations; the Prime Remembrancer's logbooks tell the expedition's fall.

name: Runefathers
summary: Aldur's chosen apprentices and artisans of runesmithing; forged the Triskelion Flame to reunite fractured Middengard.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_kalguur", "locator": "===The Triskelion Flame===: \"After Aldur had passed away, the Runefathers gathered to forge the Triskelion Flame.\""}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_aldur", "locator": "Aldur's death and the Runefathers"}]

name: Karui Slave Rebellion
summary: Rebellion of enslaved Karui in Oriath led by Utula.

name: Order of the Templar
summary: Theocratic order led by a High Templar that worships Innocence. Within the Eternal Empire it produced figures such as High Templars Andronicus and Voll; after the Cataclysm it governed the unaffected island of Oriath as the Templar Theocracy, with Dominus and Avarius as its PoE1-era High Templars.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_order_of_the_templar", "locator": "'Lore' section"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_history_of_wraeclast", "locator": "'Oriath' and 'Lycia, the Heretic' sections"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_order_of_the_templar", "locator": "intro and section 'Lore'"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_dominus", "locator": "Lore"}]

name: The Crimson Scribe
summary: Society named as the client on Heist contracts targeting the Seal of Solaris, Seal of Lunaris, Ez Myrae Tome, Staff of the First Sin Eater and Golden Ibis; its targets indicate interest in the Winter of the World and the primeval civilization.

name: The Ring
summary: Rogue guild that runs the Rogue Harbour and fulfils Heist contracts for clients such as Administrator Qotra and the Crimson Scribe. The Count Geonor passage in the wiki says he contracted the Ring. Its leader is referred to only as 'the Boss'.

name: The Unblinking Eye
summary: Mysterious group associated with the Templars involved in notable events in Wraeclast's history.

name: The Three Sisters
summary: Cross-cultural myth of the sun, moon and earth sisters who destroyed Kulemak's mortal form and ended the Winter of the World; named differently by Eternals, Maraketh, Karui, Azmeri and the Wildwood Draiocht (Catha, Mhacha, Morrigan).

name: Trarthans
summary: People of Trarthus descended from Eternal Empire exiles and slaves, led by four Great Houses.

name: The Twilight Order
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "Hidden for centuries; active ~20 years after the end of PoE1 (PoE1 present is ~1620 IC)", "story_order": null}
summary: Secret order, concealed for countless centuries, that rebuilt Oriath while the world believed it abandoned. It aims to free mankind from the 'tyranny of the gods' and build a god-free 'Utopia'; behind the scenes it is plotting to create a new Beast and trigger another Cataclysm. Led by the Countess (Oriana).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_countess", "locator": "Summary"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_twilight_order", "locator": "intro quote (Path of Exile 2 Art Book): 'The Twilight Order, however, did not flee. They emerged from countless centuries of secrecy to rebuild Oriath's heart'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_countess", "locator": "intro: 'leader of the Twilight Order... plotting to create a new Beast and start another Cataclysm'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Confront Kanu and the First Herald: Countess 'The Twilight Order will see to it that the world is remade. A world without gods... without suffering... without the disease of Divinity.'"}]

name: The Vaal
summary: Oldest identified civilisation of Wraeclast and in its heyday its most powerful nation; first known users of virtue gems, practitioners of mass blood sacrifice and slavery. All but 3,126 died in the Vaal Cataclysm; survivors assimilated into the Azmeri.

name: The Royal Architects of Atzoatl
summary: Group of Vaal architects serving Atziri who built the Temple; Incursion has Vaal Architect mini-bosses. PoE2 Medallion flavour names Architects of the Guild, Vault, Destruction, Hoard, Forge and Nexus and associates Quipolatl, Puhuarte, Juatalotli, Hayoxi, Estazunti with them.

name: Vaal survivors / Savage tribes heirs
summary: The 3,126 survivors who merged into Azmeri tribes; later Azmeri/Karui cultures inherit Vaal remnants. Descendants of Vaal blood persist (e.g. Alva Valai; the Cuachic).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_vaal", "locator": "The Vaal Cataclysm"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_vaal", "locator": "Doryani: 'a living descendant of our people'"}]

name: Vox family
summary: Oriathan nobility that became a criminal enterprise; the wiki describes the twins Vic and Vinny Vox using coercion, blackmail and violence to hold a place at the centre of Oriath business and social life. Descended from Cardinal Sanctus Vox.

name: Warbands (Redblade, Brinerot, Mutewind)
summary: Three roaming warring clans of Warbands league (2.0.0) with leaders and elites: Redblade, Brinerot, Mutewind; members Korell Goya, Guff Grenn, Rin Yuushu later joined the Syndicate.

name: Watchers of Decay
summary: Ancient organisation of parents founded when a nameless god told an Azmeri mother whose child was stolen about the Elder. They forged Starforge to subdue it by separating form and spirit. Their Map Device (Book of Memories p9) later became the Atlas device. Associated with the Order of the Djinn on the wiki; membership of Egrin/Qianga/Betucia is unclear.

name: Abyss league
summary: Abyss league Launched 2017-12-08 (version 3.1.0). Abysses are cracks and pits spawning monsters; introduces abyss jewels, Stygian Vises, Abyssal Depths and Abyssal Liches.

name: Affliction league
summary: PoE1 challenge league 3.23.0 (8 Dec 2023 - 26 Mar 2024): the player cleanses the Affliction of the Viridian Wildwood with sacred wisps, trains with the Azmeri and unlocks Wildwood ascendancy classes; the King in the Mists is the antagonist.

name: Allflame league (Curse of the Allflame)
summary: PoE1 challenge league 3.29.0 (24 Jul 2026; announced end 9 Nov 2026): aboard Valerie's ship the Sovereign, Exiles chart the Fathomless Depths with Allflame lanterns and craft with Vesper.

name: Ambush league
summary: Ambush league launched 2014-03-05 (1.1.0, Sacrifice of the Vaal); introduced Strongboxes. Ran with hardcore Invasion league.

name: Anarchy league
summary: Anarchy league launched 2013-06-07 (0.11.0); introduced rogue exiles and league challenges. Hardcore twin: Onslaught.

name: Ancestor league (Trial of the Ancestors)
summary: PoE1 challenge league 3.22.0 (18 Aug - 5 Dec 2023): Exiles use Silver Coins to enter the Karui afterlife and field a team of Karui warriors in the Trial of the Ancestors tournament against fallen chieftains, under Hinekora.

name: Archnemesis league
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "3.17.0 'Siege of the Atlas', 2022-02-04 to 2022-05-10", "story_order": null}
summary: Challenge league in which petrified monsters are imbued with itemised Archnemesis modifiers to build custom rare boss fights. Mechanics-driven; no dedicated narrative NPC in the wiki corpus.

name: Bestiary league
summary: Bestiary league Launched 2018-03-02 (version 3.2.0). Einhar Frey teaches the Exile to capture beasts with nets, for beastcrafting and to challenge the Spirit Beasts (the First Ones).

name: Betrayal league
summary: Betrayal league Launched 2018-12-07 (version 3.5.0). Jun Ortoi leads the hunt for the Immortal Syndicate, which has taken the forsaken masters; revamps the master system.

name: Beyond league
summary: Beyond league launched 2014-08-20 (1.2.0, Forsaken Masters): extradimensional demons invade via portals that grow with nearby kills, culminating in a unique boss. Hardcore twin of Rampage.

name: Blight league
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "3.8.0 'Path of Exile: Blight', 2019-09-06 to 2019-12-09", "story_order": null}
summary: Challenge league in which Sister Cassia asks the exile to defend a Purification Pump against fungal Blight growths; rewards Oils used to Anoint items.

name: Bloodlines league
summary: Bloodlines league Launched 2014-12-13 (version 1.3.0). Hardcore twin of Torment; Bloodline-empowered monsters with special modifiers. (Mechanic detail abbreviated; release data from wiki.)

name: Breach league
summary: Breach league Launched 2016-12-02 (version 2.5.0). Breaches open parallel realms of otherworldly monsters; splinters form Breachstones to challenge the five Breachlords in their domains.

name: Crucible league
summary: PoE1 challenge league 3.21.0 (7 Apr - 15 Aug 2023, 'Path of Exile: Crucible'): Crucible Forges grant equipment a passive tree, and Primeval Remnants open portals to the Forge of the Titans.

name: Delirium league
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "3.10.0 'Path of Exile: Delirium', 2020-03-13 to 2020-06-15", "story_order": null}
summary: Challenge league in which Mirrors of Delirium in each area release a spreading fog of madness; leads to the Simulacrum and Cluster Jewels.

name: Delve league
summary: Delve league Launched 2018-08-31 (version 3.4.0). Niko the Mad guides the Exile into the infinite Azurite Mine beneath Wraeclast, powered by Voltaxic Sulphite.

name: Domination league
summary: Domination league launched 2013-10-23 (1.0.0, Path of Exile release); introduced Shrines. Hardcore twin: Nemesis.

name: Echoes of the Atlas (3.13.0)
summary: League/expansion that introduced the Maven and the Envoy.

name: Essence league
summary: Essence league launched 2016-09-02 (2.4.0, Atlas of Worlds): frozen monsters hold an Essence; freeing them grants it. Essences give guaranteed affixes and can be corrupted.

name: Expedition league
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "3.15.0 'Path of Exile: Expedition', 2021-07-23 to 2021-10-18", "story_order": null}
summary: Challenge league introducing four Kalguuran expedition NPCs (Gwennen, Tujen, Rog, Dannig) who excavate the lost settlements of their ancestors with explosives. The Kalguur are referenced again in Settlers (Kingsmarch) and in PoE2.

name: Harbinger league
summary: Harbinger league launched 2017-08-04 (3.0.0, The Fall of Oriath): otherworldly Harbingers, defeated by destroying their minions, drop shards of currency.

name: Harvest league
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "3.11.0 'Path of Exile: Harvest', 2020-06-19 to 2020-09-14", "story_order": null}
summary: Challenge league in which the Azmeri outcast Oshabi has the exile plant seeds in the Sacred Grove and harvest Lifeforce for crafting; ends with the Avatar of the Grove boss. Later reworked into a core mechanic.

name: Heist league
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "3.12.0 'Path of Exile: Heist', 2020-09-18 to 2021-01-11", "story_order": null}
summary: Challenge league in which the exile uses Rogue's Markers to enter the Rogue Harbour, run Contracts for the Ring, and hire rogues to steal valuables from fortified caches (Contracts, Blueprints, Grand Heists).

name: Incursion league
summary: PoE1 3.3.0 challenge league (June 2018) in which Alva Valai opens incursions 2,000 years into the past to the Temple of Atzoatl; later became a core Master mechanic.

name: Invasion league
summary: Invasion league Launched 2014-03-05 (version 1.1.0). Hardcore twin of Ambush; invasion bosses spawn in areas. (Mechanic detail abbreviated; release data from wiki.)

name: Lake of Kalandra league
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "3.19.0 'Path of Exile: Lake of Kalandra', 2022-08-19 to 2022-12-06", "story_order": null}
aliases: ["Lake of Kalandra (League)", "Path of Exile: Lake of Kalandra"]
summary: Challenge league in which the player assembles a Mirrored Tablet of reflected encounters and enters the Lake of Kalandra, meeting the ancient trapped entity Kalandra.

name: Keepers of the Flame league
summary: PoE1 challenge league 3.27.0 (31 Oct 2025 - 2 Mar 2026): the Exile works with Ailith to repel Hiveborn invading via stabilised Breach connections and grows the Genesis Tree; Breach joined the core game in 3.28.0.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_keepers_league", "locator": "lead; Into the Breach version history"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_keepers_league", "locator": "infobox + League content"}]

name: Legion league
summary: Legion league Launched 2019-06-07 (version 3.7.0). Timeless Monoliths reveal legions frozen mid-battle; Emblems open the Domain of Timeless Conflict. Legion mechanic reworked in 3.29 per wiki (incubators no longer drop).

name: Mercenaries league (Mercenaries of Trarthus)
summary: PoE1 challenge league 3.26.0 (13 Jun - 27 Oct 2025): lawless Trarthan veterans can be fought and hired; noble mercenaries descend from the four death-trade Great Houses.

name: Metamorph league
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "3.9.0 'Conquerors of the Atlas', 2019-12-13 to 2020-03-09", "story_order": null}
summary: Challenge league in which the alchemist Tane Octavius has the exile gather organs from monsters to build shape-changing Metamorphs; introduces Catalysts.

name: Mirage league
summary: PoE1 challenge league 3.28.0 (6 Mar 2026; scheduled to end 20 Jul 2026): with Sekhema Varashta the Exile frees djinn tortured by the Afarud via mirages and the astral realm; endgame necromancer Saresh.

name: Necro Settlers event
summary: Event run Nov 2024 - Feb 2025 during the extended Settlers league, combining Necropolis content with Settlers.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_settlers_league", "locator": "intro: 'Necro Settlers event was held from November 2024 to February 2025'"}]

name: Necropolis league
summary: PoE1 challenge league 3.24.0 (29 Mar - 23 Jul 2024): Undertaker Arimor lends the Exile his Lantern to haunt monsters, collect their corpses and bury them in the Necropolis for grave crafting; Embers of the Allflame transform monsters.

name: Nemesis league
summary: Nemesis league launched 2013-10-23 (1.0.0); every rare monster has a Nemesis modifier. Standard twin: Domination.

name: Onslaught league
summary: Onslaught league launched 2013-06-07 (0.11.0); monsters have 20% increased movement and attack speed. Standard twin: Anarchy.

name: Perandus league
summary: Perandus league launched 2016-03-04 (2.2.0, Ascendancy): after the Cataclysm Cadiro Perandus hid family treasures in caches across Wraeclast; players open guarded caches and trade Perandus Coins with Cadiro.

name: Legacy of Phrecia
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "first run ended Apr 2025; 3.27-cycle rerun 29 Jan - 19 Feb 2026 (third-party news)", "story_order": null}
summary: 'Legacy of Phrecia': a limited returning PoE1 event (ascendancy/idol rework). First run ended 23 Apr 2025; it returned during the 3.27 (Keepers of the Flame) cycle from 29 Jan 2026 for about 20 days, per third-party news. Its lore link to the ancient Phrecian/imperial-heartland history is by name only (unverified).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_web_poe_vault_phrecia_end", "locator": "article on the end of the event (23 Apr 2025)"}, {"source_id": "src_ggg_legacy_of_phrecia", "locator": "official event page (not re-fetched by checker)"}, {"source_id": "src_poewiki_legacy_of_phrecia", "locator": "intro + Details"}]

name: Dawn of the Hunt
summary: PoE2 Early Access update 0.2.0 (launched 2025-04-04) and its temporary league. It added Azmeri wisps, rogue exiles and idols to the core game; not officially a full league.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_dawn_of_the_hunt_league", "locator": "lead: launched April 4, 2025 as part of Path of Exile 2: Dawn of the Hunt, version 0.2.0; ended August 26, 2025"}]

name: Fate of the Vaal
summary: 0.4.0 temporary league centred on Atziri's Temple (Lira Vaal): Ancient Beacons, the Temple Console, Royal Architect Xipocado and Queen Atziri; later moved into the core game (see 0.5 'Fate of the Vaal moving to core').

name: Forbidden Rites league (PoE2)
summary: PoE2 Early Access event league (0.5.5, 2026-09-04) built on Ritual altars in campaign and endgame zones, with unique-boss Ritual clusters per act and Sacred Bloom Wildwood encounters; 0.5.5 also integrates Runes of Aldur and Expedition into the core PoE2 game.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_forbidden_rites", "locator": "lead, 'League content' and unique boss rituals"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_forbidden_rites", "locator": "lead and League content"}]

name: Return of the Ancients / Runes of Aldur (0.5.0)
summary: 0.5.0 expansion (2026-05-29) adding the Legacy of the Precursors endgame story (Arbiter of Ash, Origin Tower, Arbiter of Divinity) and the Runes of Aldur league (Farrow, Verisium, Kalguuran runes). Runes of Aldur is expected to end before the 1.0 release.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_runes_of_aldur_league", "locator": "infobox: release 0.5.0, 2026-05-29"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_legacy_of_the_precursors", "locator": "endgame quest"}, {"source_id": "src_web_gamedeveloper_return_of_the_ancients", "locator": "Return of the Ancients storylines"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_runes_of_aldur_league", "locator": "lead: launched May 29, 2026 as part of Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients, version 0.5.0"}]

name: Rise of the Abyssal
aliases: ["Rise of the Abyssal (0.3.0)", "Rise of the Abyssal league (PoE2)"]
summary: First 'full' PoE2 league (0.3.0, 2025-08-29 to 2025-12-09): Abyssal fissures open as green cracks near monster packs; closing them reveals an Abyssal Trove and sometimes the Abyssal Depths; preserved bones feed desecration at the Well of Souls (Act 2).
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_rise_of_the_abyssal_league", "locator": "lead"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_rise_of_the_abyssal_league", "locator": "infobox: release_version 0.3.0, release_date 2025-08-29"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_rise_of_the_abyssal_league", "locator": "lead and League content"}, {"source_id": "src_ggg_content_update_0_3_0", "locator": "Rise of the Abyssals section"}]

name: Runes of Aldur
summary: 0.5.0 temporary league: Farrow studies runes on Verisium Remnants (Ezomyte Runesmithing with Kalguuran origins), producing Runic Ward, Kalguuran gems and alloys; folded into the core game with Expedition in 0.5.5.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_runes_of_aldur_league", "locator": "lead and 'League content'"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_runes_of_aldur_league", "locator": "League content"}, {"source_id": "src_web_gamedeveloper_return_of_the_ancients", "locator": "Runes of Aldur (Runesmithing): Farrow, a young blacksmith, reveals the Kalguuran origins of Ezomyte Runesmithing"}]

name: The Last of the Druids (0.4.0)
aliases: ["The Last of the Druids / Fate of the Vaal (0.4.0)"]
summary: PoE2 Early Access update 0.4.0 (2025-12-12): added the Druid class, the Fate of the Vaal league, many support gems and endgame changes.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_fate_of_the_vaal_league", "locator": "infobox: release 0.4.0, 2025-12-12"}, {"source_id": "src_web_poe2_last_of_the_druids_release", "locator": "released December 12, 2025 with Druid class and Fate of the Vaal league"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_fate_of_the_vaal_league", "locator": "lead: launched December 12, 2025 as part of The Last of the Druids, version 0.4.0"}]

name: Path of Exile 2: The Third Edict (0.3.0)
summary: Content update launching Aug 29, 2025: Act 4 (Ngamakanui), three interludes, removal of Cruel, and Rise of the Abyssal league; named after the Weapon's Third Edict.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_ggg_content_update_0_3_0", "locator": "Act Four continues from Act 3 ... Doryani agrees to help find an ancient weapon, the instrument of the Third Edict; three Interludes lead to level 65 where endgame begins; Cruel removed"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_rise_of_the_abyssal_league", "locator": "intro: launched August 29, 2025 as part of The Third Edict (0.3.0)"}, {"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_act", "locator": "Version history 0.3.0"}]

name: Prophecy league
summary: Prophecy league launched 2016-06-03 (2.3.0): silver coins traded with Navali for prophecies; the Pale Council league bosses of the Pale Court were tied to prophecies.

name: Rampage league
summary: Rampage league Launched 2014-08-20 (version 1.2.0). Kill-streak mechanic (paired with Beyond), part of Forsaken Masters. (Mechanic detail abbreviated; release data from wiki.)

name: Ritual league
chronology: {"in_world_year": null, "relative": "3.13.0 'Echoes of the Atlas', 2021-01-15 to 2021-04-12", "story_order": null}
